pédagogique',\n      coreExplanationAr: `يا أهلاً يا ${studentName}! حددي درساً من المنهج لنبدأ رحلة الشرح التفاعلي خطوة بخطوة.`,\n      coreExplanationEn: `Hello ${studentName}! Please select a lesson from the curriculum to start our guided session.`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `Bonjour ${studentName}! Choisis une leçon pour commencer.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: '',\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: '',\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: '',\n      keyRuleAr: '',\n      keyRuleEn: '',\n      keyRuleFr: '',\n      strategy,\n    };\n  }\n\n  const needsPrerequisite = diagnosisType === 'missing_prerequisite';\n  const lessonId = lesson.id;\n\n  // 0. Math: comparing fraction denominators — larger denominator = smaller pieces\n  if (lessonId === 'off_math_fractions') {\n    return {\n      headlineAr: `رسم توضيحي للمقام مع مس نور 🍕`,\n      headlineEn: `Visual Denominator Model with Miss Nour 🍕`,\n      headlineFr: `Modèle visuel du dénominateur avec Maîtresse Nour 🍕`,\n      coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `قبل مقارنة الكسور يا ${studentName}، نراجع معنى الكسر:\\nالبسط = عدد الأجزاء التي نأخذها، والمقام = عدد الأجزاء المتساوية التي نقسم إليها الوحدة.\\nلو البسط ثابت، فالمقام هو الذي يحدد حجم الجزء.`\n        : `عارفة يا ${studentName}، في الأعداد العادية ٥ أكبر من ٣. لكن في الكسور، الرقم اللي تحت (المقام) بيعبر عن عدد القطع اللي بنقسم عليها الحاجه كلها!\\nلو قسمنا نفس البيتزا على ٣ أصحاب، كل واحد هياخد شريحة كبيرة ومشبعة. لكن لو قسمنا نفس البيتزا على ٥ أصحاب، هنضطر نصغّر كل قطعة عشان تكفي الجميع!`,\n      coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `Before comparing fractions, ${studentName}, review what a fraction means: the numerator counts the parts we take, the denominator counts the equal parts of the whole. With a fixed numerator, the denominator decides the piece size.`\n        : `In whole numbers, ${studentName}, 5 is larger than 3. But in fractions the denominator tells us how many slices the whole is divided into! Sharing a pizza among 3 gives each friend a big generous slice; sharing among 5 forces much smaller pieces!`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `Plus on partage entre amis, plus chaque part est petite ! Le dénominateur décide la taille de la part.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: `نموذج المقارنة البصرية:\\n🍰 (١/٣): البيتزا مقطوعة لـ ٣ قطع كبيرة فقط.\\n🍕 (١/٥): نفس البيتزا مقطوعة لـ ٥ قطع أصغر حجماً.\\nالقاعدة الذهبية: كلما زاد المقام، صغر حجم الجزء المتساوي!`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: `Visual contrast:\\n🍰 (1/3): pizza divided into only 3 big slices.\\n🍕 (1/5): same pizza divided into 5 smaller slices.\\nGolden rule: larger denominator = smaller slice!`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: `Contraste visuel : 1/3 = 3 grandes parts ; 1/5 = 5 petites parts.`,\n      keyRuleAr: `المقام الأكبر = قطع أصغر حجماً! (١/٣ > ١/٥)`,\n      keyRuleEn: `Larger denominator = smaller slices! (1/3 > 1/5)`,\n      keyRuleFr: `Plus grand dénominateur = parts plus petites ! (1/3 > 1/5)`,\n      strategy: needsPrerequisite ? 'simpler_prerequisite' : 'visual_model',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 1. Math FR: القيمة المكانية للأعداد العشرية\n  if (lessonId === 'off_mathfr_u1_l1_decimaux') {\n    return {\n      headlineAr: `ترتيب الخانات العشرية خطوة بخطوة 📝`,\n      headlineEn: `Decimal Place Value Step-by-Step 📝`,\n      headlineFr: `Les rangs décimaux pas à pas 📝`,\n      coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `قبل القيمة المكانية العشرية يا ${studentName}، لازم نراجع خانات الأعداد الصحيحة:\\nآحاد، عشرات، مئات من اليمين لليسار.\\nبعد الفاصلة، نكمل بنفس المنطق ولكن بقيم أصغر: أجزاء من عشرة ثم من مئة ثم من ألف.`\n        : `بعد الفاصلة العشرية، كل خانة لها اسم وقيمة محددة يا ${studentName}:\\n١. الخانة الأولى: أجزاء من عشرة (Dixièmes - 0,1).\\n٢. الخانة الثانية: أجزاء من مئة (Centièmes - 0,01).\\n٣. الخانة الثالثة: أجزاء من ألف (Millièmes - 0,001).\\nفي العدد 5,842: الرقم 8 أجزاء من عشرة، و4 أجزاء من مئة، و2 أجزاء من ألف!`,\n      coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `Before decimal place value, ${studentName}, let us review whole-number places: units, tens, hundreds. After the decimal point we continue the same logic with smaller values: tenths, hundredths, thousandths.`\n        : `After the decimal point each position has a specific value, ${studentName}:\\n1. First place: Tenths (0.1)\\n2. Second place: Hundredths (0.01)\\n3. Third place: Thousandths (0.001)\\nIn 5.842: 8 is tenths, 4 is hundredths, 2 is thousandths!`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `Après la virgule, chaque rang a une valeur : dixièmes (0,1), centièmes (0,01), millièmes (0,001).`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: `تذكري ميزان السوبرماركت الإلكتروني: الكيلوجرام فيه 1000 جرام، فالخانة التالتة هي الجرامات الدقيقة!`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: `Remember a digital kitchen scale: 1 kg has 1,000 grams, so the 3rd place gives exact grams!`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: `Dans 1 kg il y a 1000 grammes, le troisième rang donne les grammes précis !`,\n      keyRuleAr: `الخانة الأولى = عشرة | الثانية = مئة | الثالثة = ألف`,\n      keyRuleEn: `1st place = tenths | 2nd = hundredths | 3rd = thousandths`,\n      keyRuleFr: `1er = dixièmes | 2e = centièmes | 3e = millièmes`,\n      strategy: needsPrerequisite ? 'simpler_prerequisite' : strategy || 'step_by_step_procedure',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 2. Math FR: مقارنة وترتيب الأعداد العشرية\n  if (lessonId === 'off_mathfr_u1_l2_comparer') {\n    return {\n      headlineAr: `مقارنة الأعداد العشرية بمساواة الخانات ⚖️`,\n      headlineEn: `Comparing Decimals by Aligning Places ⚖️`,\n      headlineFr: `Comparer les décimaux en alignant les rangs ⚖️`,\n      coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `قبل المقارنة يا ${studentName}، نراجع القيمة المكانية: بعد الفاصلة عشرة ثم مئة ثم ألف.\\nالقاعدة: نبدأ بالجزء الصحيح، ثم نقارن خانة خانة من الشمال لليمين.`\n        : `للمقارنة بين عددين عشريين يا ${studentName}:\\n١. نقارن الجزء الصحيح أولاً.\\n٢. لو تساوى، نضيف أصفاراً لمساواة عدد الخانات: 6,5 تصبح 6,50.\\n٣. نقارن من الشمال لليمين: 5 > 0 إذن 6,5 > 6,05.\\nتذكري: طول العدد بعد الفاصلة لا يعني أنه أكبر!`,\n      coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `Before comparing, ${studentName}, review place value: tenths, hundredths, thousandths. Start with the integer part, then compare place by place left to right.`\n        : `To compare two decimals, ${studentName}:\\n1. Compare the integer parts first.\\n2. If equal, pad with zeros to align places: 6.5 becomes 6.50.\\n3. Compare left to right: 5 > 0, so 6.5 > 6.05.\\nRemember: more digits after the decimal point does not mean a larger number!`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `Pour comparer : on compare la partie entière, puis on aligne les rangs avec des zéros, puis on compare de gauche à droite.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: `تخيلي صفَّين من الطوب: 6,50 و 6,05؛ الطوب التاني في الصف الأول (5) أكبر من الطوب التاني في الصف الثاني (0).`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: `Picture two rows of bricks: 6.50 and 6.05; the second brick in the first row (5) beats the second brick in the second row (0).`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: `Deux rangées : 6,50 et 6,05 ; 5 > 0 à la première décimale.`,\n      keyRuleAr: `ساوّي عدد الخانات بإضافة صفر، ثم قارن من اليسار لليمين`,\n      keyRuleEn: `Align the places with zeros, then compare left to right`,\n      keyRuleFr: `Aligner avec des zéros puis comparer de gauche à droite`,\n      strategy: needsPrerequisite ? 'simpler_prerequisite' : strategy || 'step_by_step_procedure',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 3. Math FR: الكسور المتكافئة\n  if (lessonId === 'off_mathfr_u2_l1_fractions') {\n    return {\n      headlineAr: `رسم توضيحي للكسور المتكافئة مع مس نور 🍕`,\n      headlineEn: `Visual Equivalent Fractions Model with Miss Nour 🍕`,\n      headlineFr: `Modèle visuel des fractions équivalentes 🍕`,\n      coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `قبل الكسور المتكافئة يا ${studentName}، نراجع معنى الكسر:\\nالبسط = عدد الأجزاء التي نأخذها، والمقام = عدد الأجزاء المتساوية التي نقسم إليها الوحدة.\\nلو قسمنا البيتزا لـ 3 وقسمناها لـ 6، الجزء الواحد في الحالتين يمثل نفس النسبة إذا ضاعفنا العدد.`\n        : `القاعدة الذهبية يا ${studentName}: الكسر يتغير شكله ويبقى قيمته ثابتة لما نضرب أو نقسم البسط والمقام في نفس العدد!\\nمثال: 2/3 × 2/2 = 4/6، والقيمة لم تتغير لأننا لم نأخذ أجزاء أكثر ولا أقل من نفس الوحدة.`,\n      coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `Before equivalent fractions, ${studentName}, review what a fraction means: the numerator counts the parts we take, the denominator counts the equal parts of the whole.`\n        : `The golden rule, ${studentName}: a fraction changes its look but keeps its value when we multiply or divide BOTH numerator and denominator by the same number!\\nExample: 2/3 × 2/2 = 4/6, and the value is unchanged.`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `Règle d'or : multiplier ou diviser le numérateur ET le dénominateur par le même nombre conserve la valeur de la fraction.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: `تخيلي بيتزا واحدة: قطعتان من ٣ تساوي ٤ قطع من ٦؛ نفس الكمية بالضبط لكن التقطيع أدق!`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: `One pizza: 2 slices out of 3 equals 4 slices out of 6; same amount, finer cuts!`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: `2 parts sur 3 = 4 parts sur 6 : même quantité, découpage plus fin !`,\n      keyRuleAr: `نفس العملية على البسط والمقام تحفظ قيمة الكسر`,\n      keyRuleEn: `The same operation on numerator and denominator preserves the value`,\n      keyRuleFr: `Même opération en haut et en bas ➔ même valeur`,\n      strategy: needsPrerequisite ? 'simpler_prerequisite' : strategy || 'visual_model',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 4. French: التحيات والتعريف بالنفس\n  if (lessonId === 'off_fr_u1_l1_salutations') {\n    return {\n      headlineAr: `متى نقول كل تحية فرنسية؟ 👋`,\n      headlineEn: `When Do We Use Each French Greeting? 👋`,\n      headlineFr: `Quand utiliser chaque salutation ? 👋`,\n      coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `نبدأ بالأساسيات يا ${studentName}: كلمة Salut تعني تحية، وهي مرتبطة بوقت اليوم أو بحالة اللقاء والوداع.\\nBonjour نهاراً، Bonsoir مساءً، Au revoir عند المغادرة.`\n        : `في الفرنسية يا ${studentName}، لكل موقف تحية مختلفة:\\n• Bonjour ⬅️ لقاء في النهار.\\n• Bonsoir ⬅️ لقاء في المساء.\\n• Au revoir ⬅️ عند المغادرة والوداع.\\n• Bonne nuit ⬅️ قبل النوم.\\nالخطأ الشائع: استخدام Bonjour عند الوداع!`,\n      coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `Let us start with the basics, ${studentName}: a salutation depends on the time of day and on whether we meet or leave. Bonjour by day, Bonsoir in the evening, Au revoir when leaving.`\n        : `In French, ${studentName}, each situation has its greeting:\\n• Bonjour ➔ daytime meeting\\n• Bonsoir ➔ evening meeting\\n• Au revoir ➔ when leaving\\n• Bonne nuit ➔ before sleeping\\nCommon mistake: using Bonjour to say goodbye!`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `Chaque situation a sa salutation : Bonjour (le jour), Bonsoir (le soir), Au revoir (en partant), Bonne nuit (avant de dormir).`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: `تذكري مثل باب المدرسة: داخل ⬅️ Bonjour، خارج ⬅️ Au revoir.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: `Think of the school gate: entering ➔ Bonjour, leaving ➔ Au revoir.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: `À l'entrée ➔ Bonjour ; à la sortie ➔ Au revoir.`,\n      keyRuleAr: `Bonjour للقاء النهاري | Au revoir للوداع`,\n      keyRuleEn: `Bonjour to greet by day | Au revoir to say goodbye`,\n      keyRuleFr: `Bonjour pour saluer | Au revoir pour quitter`,\n      strategy: needsPrerequisite ? 'simpler_prerequisite' : strategy || 'bilingual_vocabulary',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 5. French: أفراد العائلة وصفات الملكية\n  if (lessonId === 'off_fr_u1_l2_famille') {\n    return {\n      headlineAr: `صفات الملكية: Mon / Ma / Mes 📘`,\n      headlineEn: `Possessive Adjectives: Mon / Ma / Mes 📘`,\n      headlineFr: `Les adjectifs possessifs : Mon / Ma / Mes 📘`,\n      coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `قبل صفات الملكية يا ${studentName}، نراجع المذكر والمؤنث في الفرنسية:\\nكل اسم له جنس (مذكر أو مؤنث)، وصفة الملكية تتبعه.\\nMon للمذكر، Ma للمؤنث، Mes للجمع.`\n        : `القاعدة الأساسية يا ${studentName}:\\n• Mon ⬅️ اسم مفرد مذكر (Mon père).\\n• Ma ⬅️ اسم مفرد مؤنث (Ma mère).\\n• Mes ⬅️ جمع بنوعيه (Mes frères / Mes amis).\\nالخطأ الشائع: كتابة Ma مع اسم مذكر!`,\n      coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `Before possessive adjectives, ${studentName}, review gender in French: every noun is masculine or feminine, and the possessive adjective follows the noun's gender. Mon (masc.), Ma (fem.), Mes (plural).`\n        : `The core rule, ${studentName}:\\n• Mon ➔ masculine singular (Mon père)\\n• Ma ➔ feminine singular (Ma mère)\\n• Mes ➔ plural of either gender (Mes frères)\\nCommon mistake: using Ma with a masculine noun!`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `Mon (masculin singulier), Ma (féminin singulier), Mes (pluriel).`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: `تذكري: Mon مع père (مذكر)، Ma مع mère (مؤنث)، Mes مع frères (جمع).`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: `Remember: Mon with père (masculine), Ma with mère (feminine), Mes with frères (plural).`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: `Mon ➔ père ; Ma ➔ mère ; Mes ➔ frères.`,\n      keyRuleAr: `Mon للمذكر | Ma للمؤنث | Mes للجمع`,\n      keyRuleEn: `Mon for masculine | Ma for feminine | Mes for plural`,\n      keyRuleFr: `Mon (masc.) | Ma (fém.) | Mes (pluriel)`,\n      strategy: needsPrerequisite ? 'simpler_prerequisite' : strategy || 'bilingual_vocabulary',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 6. French: أدوات النكرة والأدوات المدرسية\n  if (lessonId === 'off_fr_u2_l1_classe') {\n    return {\n      headlineAr: `أدوات النكرة: Un / Une / Des 🎒`,\n      headlineEn: `Indefinite Articles: Un / Une / Des 🎒`,\n      headlineFr: `Les articles indéfinis : Un / Une / Des 🎒`,\n      coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `قبل أدوات النكرة يا ${studentName}، نراجع نوع الاسم وعدده:\\nهل الاسم مفرد أم جمع؟ مذكر أم مؤنث؟\\nالإجابة تحدد الأداة: Un للمذكر المفرد، Une للمؤنث المفرد، Des للجمع.`\n        : `القاعدة يا ${studentName}:\\n• Un ⬅️ مفرد مذكر (un cahier).\\n• Une ⬅️ مفرد مؤنث (une trousse).\\n• Des ⬅️ جمع (des stylos).\\nتلميحة: كلمات مثل trousse و règle مؤنثة دائماً، و cahier و livre مذكران.`,\n      coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `Before indefinite articles, ${studentName}, check the noun: singular or plural, masculine or feminine. Un (masc. sg.), Une (fem. sg.), Des (plural).`\n        : `The rule, ${studentName}:\\n• Un ➔ masculine singular (un cahier)\\n• Une ➔ feminine singular (une trousse)\\n• Des ➔ plural (des stylos)\\nTip: trousse and règle are feminine; cahier and livre are masculine.`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `Un (masculin singulier), Une (féminin singulier), Des (pluriel).`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: `اسألي عن كل كلمة: مذكر ولا مؤنث؟ مفرد ولا جمع؟ ثم اختاري الأداة.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: `For each noun ask: masculine or feminine? singular or plural? Then pick the article.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: `Masculin/féminin et singulier/pluriel décident l'article.`,\n      keyRuleAr: `Un للمذكر | Une للمؤنث | Des للجمع`,\n      keyRuleEn: `Un for masculine | Une for feminine | Des for plural`,\n      keyRuleFr: `Un (masc.) | Une (fém.) | Des (pluriel)`,\n      strategy: needsPrerequisite ? 'simpler_prerequisite' : strategy || 'bilingual_vocabulary',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 7. Science FR: احتياجات النبات والبناء الضوئي\n  if (lessonId === 'off_scifr_u1_l1_plantes') {\n    return {\n      headlineAr: `سر مطبخ النبات الأخضر والطاقة الشمسية ☀️🌱`,\n      headlineEn: `The Green Plant Kitchen & Solar Power ☀️🌱`,\n      headlineFr: `La cuisine végétale et l'énergie solaire ☀️🌱`,\n      coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `قبل البناء الضوئي يا ${studentName}، نراجع وظائف أجزاء النبات:\\nالجذور تمتص الماء والأملاح، والساق تنقلها عبر أوعية الخشب (Xylème)، والأوراق فيها الكلوروفيل الذي يلتقط الضوء.\\nالآن نقدر نفهم من أين يأتي غذاء النبات.`\n        : `كتير من الناس بيفكروا إن النبات بياكل التراب كطعام جاهز يا ${studentName}، لكن الحقيقة العلمية مدهشة:\\nالجذور بتمتص بس الماء والأملاح المعدنية من التربة، وبتبعتها عبر أنابيب الخشب (Xylème) للورقة.\\nوفي الورقة الخضراء، الكلوروفيل بيمتص ضوء الشمس زي الفرن الشمسي، وبيخلط الماء مع ثاني أكسيد الكربون لصنع سكر الجلوكوز، وينطلق الأكسجين!`,\n      coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `Before photosynthesis, ${studentName}, review plant parts: roots absorb water and minerals, the stem transports them through xylem, and leaves contain chlorophyll that captures light. Now we can see where the plant's food comes from.`\n        : `Many think plants eat soil directly, ${studentName}, but the science is fascinating:\\nRoots only absorb water and minerals and send them through xylem tubes to the leaves.\\nIn green leaves, chlorophyll captures sunlight like a solar oven, combining water with CO2 to make glucose sugar, and releasing oxygen!`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `La plante ne mange pas la terre ! Les racines absorbent l'eau et les sels minéraux ; les feuilles captent la lumière pour fabriquer le glucose par photosynthèse.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: `تخيلي مطبخ البيت: التربة بتدينا المقادير الخام (الماء)، لكن الفرن اللي بيخبز كعكة السكر هو ضوء الشمس! بدون شمس لا يوجد طعام!`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: `Think of a kitchen: soil provides the raw water ingredient, but sunlight is the oven baking the sugar meal!`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: `L'eau est l'ingrédient, mais le soleil est le four indispensable !`,\n      keyRuleAr: `ماء + ثاني أكسيد كربون + ضوء شمس ⬅️ جلوكوز + أكسجين`,\n      keyRuleEn: `Water + CO2 + sunlight ➔ glucose + oxygen`,\n      keyRuleFr: `Eau + CO2 + lumière ➔ glucose + oxygène`,\n      strategy: needsPrerequisite ? 'simpler_prerequisite' : strategy || 'visual_model',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 8. Science FR: السلاسل والشبكات الغذائية\n  if (lessonId === 'off_scifr_u1_l2_chaines') {\n    return {\n      headlineAr: `شعلة الطاقة في السلسلة الغذائية 🔥`,\n      headlineEn: `The Energy Torch in a Food Chain 🔥`,\n      headlineFr: `Le flambeau de l'énergie dans la chaîne alimentaire 🔥`,\n      coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `قبل السلسلة الغذائية يا ${studentName}، نراجع نوعي الكائنات:\\nكائن منتج يصنع غذاءه بنفسه (النبات الأخضر)، وكائن مستهلك يأكل غيره (الحيوانات).\\nومن هنا نبدأ ترتيب السلسلة.`\n        : `السلسلة الغذائية يا ${studentName} بتبدأ دايماً من الشمس، وبعدها:\\n١. المنتج (النبات الأخضر) يصنع غذاءه بنفسه.\\n٢. المستهلك الأول (عاشب مثل الأرنب) يأكل النبات.\\n٣. المستهلك الثاني (لاحم مثل الثعلب) يأكل العاشب.\\n٤. المحللات (بكتيريا وفطريات) تعيد المواد للتربة لتغلق الدورة.\\nالخطأ الشائع: نبدأ السلسلة من الحيوان المفترس!`,\n      coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `Before food chains, ${studentName}, review two kinds of organisms: producers that make their own food (green plants) and consumers that eat others (animals). That is how a chain is ordered.`\n        : `A food chain always starts with the sun, ${studentName}:\\n1. Producer (green plant) makes its own food.\\n2. Primary consumer (herbivore, e.g. rabbit) eats the plant.\\n3. Secondary consumer (carnivore, e.g. fox) eats the herbivore.\\n4. Decomposers (bacteria, fungi) return minerals to the soil and close the cycle.\\nCommon mistake: starting the chain with the predator!`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `La chaîne alimentaire commence par le soleil, puis le producteur, puis les consommateurs, et se ferme avec les décomposeurs.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: `مثل تمرير شعلة الألعاب الأولمبية: الشمس تعطي الشعلة للنبات، والنبات يمررها لباقي الحيوانات.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: `Like passing an Olympic torch: the sun hands the flame to plants, which pass it to animals.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: `Comme un flambeau olympique : du soleil aux plantes, puis aux animaux.`,\n      keyRuleAr: `شمس ⬅️ منتج ⬅️ مستهلك أول ⬅️ مستهلك ثاني ⬅️ محللات`,\n      keyRuleEn: `Sun ➔ producer ➔ primary consumer ➔ secondary consumer ➔ decomposers`,\n      keyRuleFr: `Soleil ➔ producteur ➔ consommateurs ➔ décomposeurs`,\n      strategy: needsPrerequisite ? 'simpler_prerequisite' : strategy || 'visual_model',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 9. Arabic grammar: الجملة الاسمية وركناها\n  if (lessonId === 'off_ar_u1_l3_grammar_nominal') {\n    return {\n      headlineAr: `ركنا الجملة الاسمية: المبتدأ والخبر 🧩`,\n      headlineEn: `Nominal Sentence Elements: Subject & Predicate 🧩`,\n      headlineFr: `Les deux piliers de la phrase nominale 🧩`,\n      coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `قبل الجملة الاسمية يا ${studentName}، نراجع أقسام الكلمة: اسم، فعل، حرف.\\nالجملة الاسمية هي التي تبدأ باسم، ولو بدأت بفعل فهي جملة فعلية.\\nوهنا نتعرف على ركنيها المبتدأ والخبر.`\n        : `الجملة الاسمية يا ${studentName} تبدأ باسم ولها ركنان:\\n• المبتدأ: الاسم الذي نبدأ به الجملة وتدور حوله الفكرة.\\n• الخبر: الجزء الذي يتمم المعنى ويكتمل به الكلام.\\nوكلاهما مرفوع دائماً: بالضمة للمفرد، والألف للمثنى، والواو لجمع المذكر السالم.\\nفي «النيلُ شريانُ الحياة»: النيلُ مبتدأ، شريانُ خبر.`,\n      coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `Before the nominal sentence, ${studentName}, review word classes: noun, verb, particle. A sentence that opens with a noun is nominal; one that opens with a verb is verbal.`\n        : `A nominal sentence, ${studentName}, opens with a noun and has two pillars:\\n• Subject (المبتدأ): the noun we start with and the idea revolves around.\\n• Predicate (الخبر): the part that completes the meaning.\\nBoth are always nominative: damma for singular, alif for dual, waw for masculine plural.\\nIn «النيلُ شريانُ الحياة»: النيلُ is subject, شريانُ is predicate.`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `La phrase nominale commence par un nom : sujet (المبتدأ) + attribut (الخبر), tous deux au nominatif.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: `مثل اسم وعنوان: المبتدأ هو الاسم اللي بيفتح الجملة، والخبر هو اللي بيوصفه ويكمل الكلام.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: `Like a name and a title: the subject opens the sentence, the predicate describes it and completes the meaning.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: `Le sujet ouvre la phrase, l'attribut la complète.`,\n      keyRuleAr: `المبتدأ والخبر مرفوعان دائماً: ضمة، أو ألف، أو واو`,\n      keyRuleEn: `Subject and predicate are always nominative: damma, alif, or waw`,\n      keyRuleFr: `Sujet et attribut sont toujours au nominatif`,\n      strategy: needsPrerequisite ? 'simpler_prerequisite' : strategy || 'step_by_step_procedure',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 10. Arabic reading: قصة «أنا أستطيع»\n  if (lessonId === 'off_ar_u1_l1_ana_astatee') {\n    return {\n      headlineAr: `الفشل خطوة أولى نحو النجاح 💪`,\n      headlineEn: `Failure Is the First Step to Success 💪`,\n      headlineFr: `L'échec est le premier pas vers la réussite 💪`,\n      coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `قبل ما نحلل القصة يا ${studentName}، نراجع عناصرها: مين البطل؟ آسر.\\nإيه المشكلة؟ تقدير ضعيف وإحساس بالإحباط.\\nمين ساعده؟ المعلم وصديقه حسن. وإيه النتيجة؟ الفوز بالمركز الأول.`\n        : `القصة يا ${studentName} بتحمل رسالة واضحة:\\nالمعلم قال لآسر: «إن الخطأ خطوة في طريق التعلم، ومن لا يخطئ لا يتعلم أبداً».\\nوحكاية الحصان في الحفرة توضح إن كل كومة تراب بتقع علينا نقدر ننفضها ونطلع خطوة لفوق!\\nالخطأ الشائع: فهم القصة على أنها دعوة للتجنب أو الاتكالية، لكن آسر تفانى وقسّم المهام مع فريقه وفاز.`,\n      coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n        ? `Before analysing the story, ${studentName}, review its elements: who is the hero? Aser. What is the problem? A low mark and discouragement. Who helps? His teacher and his friend Hassan. What is the result? Winning first place.`\n        : `The story carries a clear message, ${studentName}:\\nThe teacher told Aser: \"A mistake is a step on the path of learning, and whoever never errs never learns.\"\\nThe horse-in-the-pit tale shows that every pile of soil thrown on us can be shaken off to climb one step higher!\\nCommon mistake: reading the story as an invitation to avoidance or dependency, while Aser worked hard and shared the tasks to win.`,\n      coreExplanationFr: `Le message : l'échec n'est pas une fin, mais un pas vers la réussite grâce à la persévérance et au travail d'équipe.`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyAr: `مثل الطفل وهو بيتعلم المشي: يقع عشرات المرات ويقف تاني حتى يجري!`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyEn: `Like a toddler learning to walk: falling many times, then standing again until they run!`,\n      contrastOrAnalogyFr: `Comme un enfant qui apprend à marcher : il tombe, se relève, puis court !`,\n      keyRuleAr: `الفشل خطوة في طريق التعلم، والإصرار والعمل الجماعي يحققان النجاح`,\n      keyRuleEn: `Failure is a step in learning; persistence and teamwork achieve success`,\n      keyRuleFr: `L'échec est une étape d'apprentissage ; la persévérance mène au succès`,\n      strategy: needsPrerequisite ? 'simpler_prerequisite' : strategy || 'everyday_analogy',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 11. Grounded fallback from the lesson's own concept metadata (never invented).\n  return {\n    headlineAr: `شرح مركز ومبسط لقاعدة درس «${lesson.titleAr}» 💡`,\n    headlineEn: `Targeted Concept Breakdown for \"${lesson.titleEn}\" 💡`,\n    headlineFr: `Explication ciblée pour «${lesson.titleEn}» 💡`,\n    coreExplanationAr: needsPrerequisite\n      ? `يا ${studentName}، قبل الشرح نراجع الأساس التمهيدي للدرس: ${concept?.prerequisiteAr || lesson.objectives[0] || 'المفاهيم السابقة'}.`\n      : `يا ${studentName}، القاعدة الأساسية في كتاب الوزارة هي: ${concept?.sourceText || lesson.objectives[0] || 'تطبيق الخطوات المنهجية بدقة'}. المهم نركز على تسلسل الخطوات وفهم المعنى قبل الحل.`,\n    coreExplanationEn: needsPrerequisite\n      ? `Before we teach, ${studentName}, let us review the prerequisite: ${concept?.prerequisiteEn || lesson.objectives[0] || 'prior concepts'}.`\n      : `The core textbook principle, ${studentName}, is: ${concept?.sourceText || lesson.objectives[0] || 'Methodical application'}. Focus on the step sequence and understanding.`,\n    coreExplanationFr: `Le principe fondamental du manuel est : ${concept?.sourceText || lesson.objectives[0] || 'Application rigoureuse'}.`,\n    contrastOrAnalogyAr: concept?.dailyLifeExampleAr || concept?.storyAnalogyAr || `مثل خطوات تركيب أي شيء بنجاح: خطوة بخطوة بالترتيب الصحيح!`,\n    contrastOrAnalogyEn: concept?.dailyLifeExampleEn || `Like building anything successfully: one step at a time!`,\n    contrastOrAnalogyFr: `Comme tout travail bien fait : étape par étape !`,\n    keyRuleAr: concept?.keyPoints?.[0] || lesson.objectives[0] || 'التركيز والتطبيق المنهجي المباشر',\n    keyRuleEn: concept?.keyPoints?.[0] || 'Methodical focus and application',\n    keyRuleFr: 'Rigueur et méthode',\n    strategy: strategy || 'guided_practice',\n  };\n}\n\nexport function buildTargetedIntervention(\n  lesson: OfficialCurriculumLesson | null,\n  concept: CurriculumLessonConcept | null,\n  studentName: string,\n  diagnosisType: ErrorDiagnosisType,\n  strategy: TeachingStrategy\n): TargetedTeachingContent {\n  return buildTargetedInterventionRaw(lesson, concept, studentName, diagnosisType, strategy);\n}\n\n/**\n * Deterministically analyzes Amina's typed or spoken reasoning.\n * Classifies reasoning into 8 distinct categories, detecting guessing,\n * specific misconceptions, prerequisite gaps, and distinguishing sound from weak reasoning.\n */\nexport function analyzeStudentReasoning(\n  reasoningText: string,\n  selectedOption: DiagnosticOption,\n  concept: CurriculumLessonConcept | null,\n  lesson: OfficialCurriculumLesson,\n  language: Language\n): ReasoningAnalysisResult {\n  const text = (reasoningText || '').trim().toLowerCase();\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n  const isFr = language === 'fr';\n\n  // 1. Unclear / Missing Reasoning (insufficient input)\n  if (text.length === 0) {\n    return {\n      category: 'unclear_reasoning',\n      confidence: 'low',\n      explanationAr: 'لم تسجل أمينة تعليلاً كافياً؛ نحتاج لسؤال استكشافي لتحديد طريقة تفكيرها بدقة.',\n      explanationEn: 'No reasoning text provided; exploratory questioning needed.',\n      explanationFr: 'Aucun raisonnement fourni ; questionnement nécessaire.',\n      recommendedPedagogicalAction: 'clarify_thinking_with_new_example',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 2. Guessing Detection\n  const guessingTerms = [\n    'تخمين', 'مش عارفة', 'مش متاكدة', 'مش متأكدة', 'حظ', 'يمكن', 'شكيت',\n    'اخترت وخلاص', 'ماعرفش', 'ضربة حظ', 'حسيت كدة', 'بالبركة',\n    'guess', 'guessed', 'guessing', 'not sure', 'lucky', 'maybe', 'just picked', 'dunno', 'no idea',\n    'au hasard', 'hasard', 'pas sûre', 'je ne sais pas', 'peut-être', 'deviné',\n  ];\n  const isGuessing = guessingTerms.some((term) => text.includes(term));\n  if (isGuessing) {\n    return {\n      category: 'guessing',\n      confidence: 'high',\n      explanationAr: 'أمينة تعتمد على التخمين أو غير متأكدة من إجابتها؛ لا يمكن اعتماد الإتقان قبل توضيح القاعدة وتثبيتها.',\n      explanationEn: 'Student is guessing or uncertain; cannot assume mastery without reinforcing the rule.',\n      explanationFr: 'L’élève devine ou hésite ; consolidation nécessaire avant validation.',\n      recommendedPedagogicalAction: 'guided_step_by_step',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 3. Prerequisite Gap Detection\n  const prerequisiteGapTerms = [\n    'مش فاكرة يعني ايه', 'نسيت', 'مش فاهمة الأساس', 'يعني ايه كسر أصلاً', 'ما أخدتهاش', 'ما درستهاش',\n    'يعني إيه بسط', 'يعني إيه مقام', 'نسيت الدرس القديم',\n    'forgot', \"don't know what\", 'forgot the basics', 'never learned', \"what is fraction\",\n    'oublié', 'pas compris les bases', 'jamais appris', \"c'est quoi\",\n  ];\n  const isPrerequisiteGap = prerequisiteGapTerms.some((term) => text.includes(term)) ||\n    selectedOption.diagnosisType === 'missing_prerequisite';\n  if (isPrerequisiteGap && (!selectedOption.isCorrect || text.includes('نسيت') || text.includes('مش فاكرة'))) {\n    return {\n      category: 'prerequisite_gap',\n      confidence: 'high',\n      explanationAr: 'فجوة في المتطلبات الأساسية السابقة للدرس؛ يجب تثبيت الأساسيات والمفاهيم التمهيدية أولاً.',\n      explanationEn: 'Prerequisite foundational gap detected; foundational material needed first.',\n      explanationFr: 'Lacune dans les prérequis fondamentaux ; révision de base nécessaire.',\n      recommendedPedagogicalAction: 'reinforce_prerequisite',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 4. Vocabulary / Language Difficulty Detection\n  const vocabConfusionTerms = [\n    'مش فاهمة الكلمة', 'المصطلح ملخبطني', 'الكلمة بالفرنسي', 'مش عارفة معنى',\n    'الترجمة', 'الكلمات شبه بعض',\n    'confused the word', \"don't know this word\", 'vocabulary', 'term translation',\n    'le mot', 'pas compris le terme', 'vocabulaire', 'traduction',\n  ];\n  const isVocabDifficulty = vocabConfusionTerms.some((term) => text.includes(term)) ||\n    selectedOption.diagnosisType === 'vocabulary_confusion';\n  if (isVocabDifficulty) {\n    return {\n      category: 'vocabulary_difficulty',\n      confidence: 'high',\n      explanationAr: 'صعوبة لغوية أو التباس في المصطلحات والمفردات ثنائية اللغة.',\n      explanationEn: 'Language or bilingual terminology difficulty detected.',\n      explanationFr: 'Difficulté avec le vocabulaire bilingue.',\n      recommendedPedagogicalAction: 'bilingual_clarification',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 5. Specific Conceptual Misconceptions\n  // A named misconception key is only reported when the student's own wording or the\n  // lesson source actually supports it. Otherwise we report a generic misconception\n  // without inventing a specific one.\n  const conceptSourceText = [\n    lesson.titleAr,\n    lesson.titleEn,\n    concept?.titleAr || '',\n    concept?.titleEn || '',\n    concept?.sourceText || '',\n    lesson.readingText || '',\n  ]\n    .join(' ')\n    .toLowerCase();\n  const isFractionLesson = /كسر|كسور|fraction/.test(conceptSourceText);\n\n  // Fraction denominator misconception (comparing fractions with a fixed numerator):\n  const fractionMisconceptionTerms = [\n    'المقام أكبر', '٥ أكبر من ٣', '5 اكبر من 3', 'الرقم الكبير', 'خمسة أكبر',\n    'عشان 5 أكبر', 'الخمسة اكبر', 'علشان ٥', 'الرقم 5 كبير',\n    'denominator is bigger', '5 is bigger', 'bigger denominator', 'larger number',\n    'plus grand nombre', '5 est plus grand',\n  ];\n  if (\n    isFractionLesson &&\n    (fractionMisconceptionTerms.some((t) => text.includes(t)) ||\n      (!selectedOption.isCorrect && selectedOption.diagnosisType === 'misconception'))\n  ) {\n    return {\n      category: 'misconception',\n      confidence: 'high',\n      explanationAr: 'سوء فهم تصوري محدد: تطبيق قاعدة الأعداد الصحيحة على مقامات الكسور أو عكس معنى المفهوم.',\n      explanationEn: 'Specific conceptual misconception: applying whole number intuition to fraction denominators.',\n      explanationFr: 'Erreur conceptuelle spécifique identifiée.',\n      detectedMisconceptionKey: 'denominator_magnitude_misconception',\n      recommendedPedagogicalAction: 'target_misconception',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Science plant needs misconception (soil as food):\n  const plantMisconceptionTerms = ['بتاكل تراب', 'بتاكل طين', 'التربة طعام', 'التربة هي الأكل', 'eats soil', 'soil is food', 'terre est nourriture'];\n  if (plantMisconceptionTerms.some((t) => text.includes(t))) {\n    return {\n      category: 'misconception',\n      confidence: 'high',\n      explanationAr: 'سوء فهم بيولوجي: افتراض أن التربة طعام جاهز بدلاً من إدراك دور البناء الضوئي.',\n      explanationEn: 'Biological misconception: assuming soil is food rather than understanding photosynthesis.',\n      explanationFr: 'Idée fausse biologique : penser que le sol est la nourriture de la plante.',\n      detectedMisconceptionKey: 'soil_eating_misconception',\n      recommendedPedagogicalAction: 'target_misconception',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Generic misconception: the selected option is marked as a misconception, but no\n  // specific named misconception is supported by the available material.\n  if (!selectedOption.isCorrect && selectedOption.diagnosisType === 'misconception') {\n    return {\n      category: 'misconception',\n      confidence: 'medium',\n      explanationAr: 'الاختيار يعكس فهماً غير دقيق للمفهوم، وسنعالجه بشرح مباشر من مادة الدرس.',\n      explanationEn: 'The choice reflects an inaccurate understanding of the concept; we will address it from the lesson material.',\n      explanationFr: 'Le choix reflète une compréhension inexacte ; nous allons le traiter à partir du cours.',\n      recommendedPedagogicalAction: 'target_misconception',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 6. Procedural or Calculation Error\n  const proceduralTerms = [\n    'حسبت غلط', 'جمعت بدل ما أطرح', 'بدلت الخانات', 'تلخبطت في الحساب', 'خطوات ملخبطة',\n    'miscalculated', 'added instead of subtracted', 'swapped positions', 'calculation slip',\n    'erreur de calcul', 'inversé les rangs',\n  ];\n  if (proceduralTerms.some((t) => text.includes(t)) || selectedOption.diagnosisType === 'calculation_or_procedure') {\n    return {\n      category: 'procedural_error',\n      confidence: 'high',\n      explanationAr: 'خطأ إجرائي أو حسابي في تسلسل الخطوات مع وضوح الفكرة العامة.',\n      explanationEn: 'Procedural or calculation step error with basic concept intact.',\n      explanationFr: 'Erreur de procédure ou de calcul.',\n      recommendedPedagogicalAction: 'guided_step_by_step',\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 7. Sound / Correct Reasoning\n  if (selectedOption.isCorrect) {\n    const soundCausalTerms = [\n      'لأن', 'عشان', 'علشان', 'قسمنا', 'نصيب', 'أجزاء', 'كلما', 'صغر', 'بما أن',\n      'قطعة', 'التقسيم', 'مقام', 'شمس', 'بناء ضوئي', 'فاعل', 'أنا أستطيع', 's’appeler',\n      'because', 'since', 'divide', 'divided', 'share', 'shared', 'parts', 'smaller', 'pieces',\n      'parce que', 'car', 'partagé', 'divisé', 'parts', 'morceau',\n    ];\n    const hasCausalExplanation = soundCausalTerms.some((term) => text.includes(term));\n\n    // If student gave a rich causal justification:\n    if (hasCausalExplanation && text.length >= 8) {\n      return {\n        category: 'correct_reasoning',\n        confidence: 'high',\n        explanationAr: 'تفكير سليم ومنطقي يعلل الإجابة بناءً على الفهم الحقيقي للمفهوم.',\n        explanationEn: 'Sound, logical reasoning justifying the answer through genuine concept comprehension.',\n        explanationFr: 'Raisonnement rigoureux et fondé sur la compréhension réelle.',\n        recommendedPedagogicalAction: 'praise_and_challenge',\n      };\n    }\n\n    // If answer is correct but reasoning is minimal / terse (e.g. \"صح وخلاص\", \"it's right\")\n    if (text.length < 8 || text.includes('صح وخلاص') || text.includes('كده') || text.includes('yes')) {\n      return {\n        category: 'incomplete_reasoning',\n        confidence: 'medium',\n        explanationAr: 'الإجابة صحيحة ولكن التعليل مختصر أو سطحي؛ نحتاج لتأكيد الفهم بمثال تطبيقي جديد.',\n        explanationEn: 'Answer is correct but reasoning is brief or surface-level; verification on new example needed.',\n        explanationFr: 'Réponse correcte mais justification incomplète ; vérification requise.',\n        recommendedPedagogicalAction: 'clarify_thinking_with_new_example',\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 8. Incomplete or Unclear Reasoning (Fallback avoiding false certainty)\n  return {\n    category: 'unclear_reasoning',\n    confidence: 'medium',\n    explanationAr: 'التعليل غير واضح تماماً؛ سنختبر الفهم بمثال جديد وتوجيه لطيف لنتبين طريقة التفكير.',\n    explanationEn: 'Reasoning is ambiguous; Miss Nour will test understanding on a new guided example.',\n    explanationFr: 'Raisonnement encore ambigu ; nous allons clarifier avec un nouvel exemple guidé.',\n    recommendedPedagogicalAction: 'clarify_thinking_with_new_example',\n  };\n}\n\nexport interface TeachingOutcomeEvaluationParams {\n  initialDiagnosticCorrect: boolean;\n  initialReasoningCategory: ReasoningCategory;\n  recheckCorrect: boolean;\n  recheckReasoningCategory: ReasoningCategory;\n  attemptsCount: number;\n}\n\n/**\n * Determines the genuine teaching outcome based on the complete pedagogical chain:\n * Answer 1 + Reasoning 1 -> Teaching Intervention -> Answer 2 + Reasoning 2.\n */\nexport function evaluateTeachingOutcome(params: TeachingOutcomeEvaluationParams): {\n  outcome: TeachingDecisionOutcome;\n  rationaleAr: string;\n  rationaleEn: string;\n  rationaleFr: string;\n  evidenceCorrectness: 'full' | 'partial' | 'wrong';\n  evidenceIndependence: 'unassisted' | 'hinted' | 'revealed';\n  reviewIntervalDays: number;\n} {\n  const {\n    initialDiagnosticCorrect,\n    initialReasoningCategory,\n    recheckCorrect,\n    recheckReasoningCategory,\n    attemptsCount: _attemptsCount,\n  } = params;\n\n  // Outcome 5: NOT_YET_LEARNED (Missing prerequisite foundations)\n  if (\n    initialReasoningCategory === 'prerequisite_gap' ||\n    recheckReasoningCategory === 'prerequisite_gap'\n  ) {\n    return {\n      outcome: 'not_yet_learned',\n      rationaleAr: 'تم رصد فجوة في المتطلبات الأساسية السابقة للدرس؛ يجب تثبيت الأساسيات أولاً قبل التقدم في هذا المفهوم.',\n      rationaleEn: 'Prerequisite knowledge gap detected; foundational material must be mastered before progressing.',\n      rationaleFr: 'Prérequis manquant ; consolidation des bases requise avant de poursuivre.',\n      evidenceCorrectness: 'wrong',\n      evidenceIndependence: 'revealed',\n      reviewIntervalDays: 1,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Outcome 1: MASTERED\n  // Must demonstrate correct answer AND sound reasoning on the re-check example\n  if (\n    recheckCorrect &&\n    (recheckReasoningCategory === 'correct_reasoning' ||\n      (initialDiagnosticCorrect && initialReasoningCategory === 'correct_reasoning'))\n  ) {\n    const isUnassisted = initialDiagnosticCorrect && initialReasoningCategory === 'correct_reasoning';\n    return {\n      outcome: 'mastered',\n      rationaleAr: 'إتقان تام مثبت! أجابت أمينة بشكل صحيح مع تعليل منطقي سليم على مثال تطبيقي جديد.',\n      rationaleEn: 'Fully mastered! Amina answered correctly with sound reasoning verified on a new example.',\n      rationaleFr: 'Parfaitement maîtrisé ! Réponse exacte avec raisonnement rigoureux sur un nouvel exemple.',\n      evidenceCorrectness: 'full',\n      evidenceIndependence: isUnassisted ? 'unassisted' : 'hinted',\n      reviewIntervalDays: 14,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Outcome 2: ALMOST\n  // Re-check is correct, but reasoning has minor incompleteness / uncertainty\n  if (recheckCorrect) {\n    return {\n      outcome: 'almost',\n      rationaleAr: 'استيعاب جيد جداً ومقارب للإتقان؛ الإجابة صحيحة مع حاجة لتمرين تطبيقي إضافي لتثبيت الثقة التامة.',\n      rationaleEn: 'Almost mastered! Correct answer with minor reasoning weakness; one targeted exercise needed.',\n      rationaleFr: 'Presque maîtrisé ! Over time, score drifts toward 0.5 floor\n * - Decay accelerates when evidenceCount is low\n * - Decay is paused for concepts actively in review (within grace period)\n */\nexport function applyDecay(\n  record: MasteryRecord,\n  currentTime: Date | string | number = new Date(),\n  simulatedDaysElapsed?: number\n): MasteryRecord {\n  if (record.evidenceCount === 0) {\n    return record;\n  }\n\n  let daysElapsed = 0;\n  if (typeof simulatedDaysElapsed === 'number' && simulatedDaysElapsed >= 0) {\n    daysElapsed = simulatedDaysElapsed;\n  } else {\n    const now = typeof currentTime === 'object' ? currentTime.getTime() : new Date(currentTime).getTime();\n    const last = new Date(record.lastUpdated).getTime();\n    daysElapsed = Math.max(0, (now - last) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));\n  }\n\n  // Grace period: decay is paused for actively reviewed concepts (within 1.5 days)\n  if (daysElapsed <= 1.5) {\n    return record;\n  }\n\n  const effectiveDaysToDecay = daysElapsed - 1.5;\n\n  // Decay accelerates when evidence count is low (fragile memory)\n  // A concept with 1 piece of evidence decays faster than one with 10 pieces\n  const lowEvidenceMultiplier = 1.0 + Math.max(0, (6 - record.evidenceCount) * 0.25);\n  const dailyDecayRate = (record.decayRate / 7) * lowEvidenceMultiplier;\n\n  // Decay factor compounded\n  const totalDecayStep = effectiveDaysToDecay * dailyDecayRate;\n\n  let decayedScore = record.score;\n  if (record.score > SCORE_FLOOR) {\n    // Drifts downward toward 0.5 floor\n    decayedScore = Math.max(SCORE_FLOOR, record.score - totalDecayStep * (record.score - SCORE_FLOOR));\n  } else if (record.score < SCORE_FLOOR) {\n    // Drifts upward toward 0.5 floor\n    decayedScore = Math.min(SCORE_FLOOR, record.score + totalDecayStep * (SCORE_FLOOR - record.score));\n  }\n\n  // Confidence also gently experiences entropy over long periods of non-practice\n  const confidenceEntropy = effectiveDaysToDecay * 0.003;\n  const decayedConfidence = Math.max(0.15, record.confidence - confidenceEntropy);\n\n  return {\n    ...record,\n    score: Number(decayedScore.toFixed(4)),\n    confidence: Number(decayedConfidence.toFixed(4)),\n    decayAppliedCount: (record.decayAppliedCount || 0) + 1,\n    lastDecayCheck: new Date().toISOString(),\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Calculates current threshold:\n * - mastered     : score >= 0.85 AND confidence >= 0.70\n * - needs_review : score < 0.60 OR (decayed) score < 0.70\n * - learning     : everything else\n */\nexport function getMasteryThreshold(score: number, confidence: number): MasteryThreshold {\n  if (score >= 0.85 && confidence >= 0.70) {\n    return 'mastered';\n  }\n  if (score < 0.60 || (score < 0.70 && confidence >= 0.40)) {\n    return 'needs_review';\n  }\n  return 'learning';\n}\n\n/**\n * Calculates confidence band:\n * - 'لم يبدأ بعد (دون أدلة)' : 'Not started (no evidence yet)',\n      hasEvidence: false,\n    };\n  }\n\n  const scorePct = Math.round(record.score * 100);\n  const confPct = Math.round(record.confidence * 100);\n  const band = getConfidenceBand(record.confidence);\n  const threshold = getMasteryThreshold(record.score, record.confidence);\n\n  let bandLabel = '';\n  switch (band) {\n    case 'high':\n      bandLabel = isArabic ? Let us return to the chalkboard!`;\n      speakText(congrats, 'celebrating');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Vocabulary Card Tap\n  const handleSelectVocabCard = (idx: number) => {\n    soundEffects.playPop();\n    setActiveVocabIndex(idx);\n    const card = vocabCards[idx];\n    const text = isArabic\n      ? `مصطلح «${card.word}»: معناه في كتاب الوزارة: ${card.meaningAr}`\n      : isFrench\n      ? `Mot «${card.word}»: définition: ${card.meaningFr}`\n      : `Vocabulary word \"${card.word}\": ${card.meaningEn}`;\n    speakText(text, 'talking');\n  };\n\n  // Ask Teacher question handler\n  const handleAskQuestion = async () => {\n    const q = askInput.trim();\n    if (!q) return;\n\n    soundEffects.playPop();\n    setIsAnswering(true);\n    setAskInput('');\n    setNourState('thinking');\n\n    try {\n      const resp = await fetch('/api/tutor-reply', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          studentInput: q,\n          currentBeatText: currentLesson.readingText || currentLesson.objectives.join(' - '),\n          lessonTitle: isArabic ? currentLesson.titleAr : currentLesson.titleEn,\n          subjectName: isArabic ? currentLesson.sourceRef.bookAr : currentLesson.sourceRef.bookEn,\n          studentName,\n          language,\n        }),\n      });\n\n      const data = await resp.json();\n      const answer = data.reply || (isArabic ? `أنا سامعاكي ومركّزة معاكي يا ${studentName}!` : `I hear you loud and clear, ${studentName}!`);\n      speakText(answer, 'talking');\n    } catch {\n      const fallback = isArabic\n        ? `سؤال ذكي جداً يا ${studentName}! في درسنا «${currentLesson.titleAr}»، أهم نقطة هي: ${currentLesson.objectives[0] || 'التركيز والتعلم المستمر'}.`\n        : `Great question, ${studentName}! In our lesson \"${currentLesson.titleEn}\", the core idea is: ${currentLesson.objectives[0] || 'Keep exploring'}.`;\n      speakText(fallback, 'talking');\n    } finally {\n      setIsAnswering(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const subjectMeta = SUBJECT_METADATA[currentLesson.subjectId] || {\n    icon: '📚',\n    color: 'indigo',\n    bgGradient: 'from-indigo-600 to-indigo-800',\n    termLabel: 'الفصل الدراسي الأول',\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div\n      className=\"flex-1 flex flex-col p-3 sm:p-4 max-w-lg mx-auto w-full pb-24 select-none space-y-2.5\"\n      dir={isArabic ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}\n    >\n      {/* 1. TOP CLASSROOM BANNER: TEACHER BADGE, STARS JAR, AUDIO TEST & BELL */}\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between bg-white dark:bg-slate-800/95 rounded-2xl p-2.5 px-3 shadow-xs border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n          <div className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-linear-to-br from-amber-400 to-amber-500 text-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center text-base font-black shadow-xs\">\n            👩‍🏫\n          </div>\n          <div>\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n              <h2 className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n                {isArabic ? 'فصل المعلمة نور' : isFrench ? 'Classe de Maîtresse Nour' : \"Miss Nour's Classroom\"}\n              </h2>\n              <span className=\"px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-md text-[9px] font-black bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800\">\n                {isArabic ? 'الصف الخامس' : 'Grade 5'}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n            <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400\">\n              {isArabic ? 'شرح ذكي • صوت حقيقي • كتاب الوزارة' : 'Smart Voice Tutor • Ministry Textbooks'}\n            </p>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Right side controls: Sound test, Star jar, Bell, Audio mute */}\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n          {/* Quick Voice Sound Test Button */}\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            onClick={handleVoiceTest}\n            className=\"px-2 py-1 rounded-xl bg-linear-to-r from-emerald-500 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-400 hover:to-teal-500 text-white font-black text-[10px] shadow-xs transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer\"\n            title={isArabic ? 'اختبار صوت المعلمة نور' : \"Test Miss Nour's Voice\"}\n          >\n            <Headphones className=\"w-3 h-3\" />\n            <span className=\"hidden xs:inline\">{isArabic ? 'صوت' : 'Audio'}</span>\n          </button>\n\n          {/* Star Jar */}\n          <div\n            className=\"flex items-center gap-1 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800/60 px-2 py-1 rounded-xl text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300 font-black text-xs shadow-xs\"\n            title={isArabic ? 'برطمان النجوم الذهبية' : 'Gold Star Jar'}\n          >\n            <Star className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-amber-400 text-amber-500 animate-spin-slow\" />\n            <span>{starsCount}</span>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* School Bell */}\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            onClick={handleRingBell}\n            className=\"p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer\"\n            title={isArabic ? 'دق جرس الحصة 🔔' : 'Ring School Bell'}\n          >\n            <Bell className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n          </button>\n\n          {/* Mute Sound FX */}\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            onClick={handleToggleSound}\n            className={`p-1.5 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer ${\n              soundEnabled\n                ? 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200'\n                : 'bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950 text-rose-600'\n            }`}\n          >\n            {soundEnabled ? <Volume2 className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" /> : <VolumeX className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />}\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* 2. ACTIVE LESSON SELECTOR STRIP: BUTTON TO CHANGE SUBJECT OR LESSON */}\n      <div className=\"bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-700 via-indigo-800 to-purple-800 text-white p-2.5 rounded-2xl shadow-md flex items-center justify-between gap-2\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0\">\n          <span className=\"text-xl shrink-0 p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xs border border-white/20\">\n            {subjectMeta.icon}\n          </span>\n          <div className=\"min-w-0\">\n            <span className=\"text-[9px] font-bold text-indigo-200 block truncate\">\n              {currentLesson.sourceRef.bookAr} • ص. {currentLesson.sourceRef.page || 1}\n            </span>\n            <h3 className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-black truncate\">\n              «{isArabic ? currentLesson.titleAr : currentLesson.titleEn}»\n            </h3>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          onClick={() => setIsPickerOpen(true)}\n          className=\"shrink-0 py-1.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-300 text-slate-950 font-black text-[11px] shadow-xs transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1\"\n        >\n          <span>📚</span>\n          <span>{isArabic ? 'تغيير الدرس' : isFrench ? 'Changer' : 'Switch'}</span>\n          <ChevronDown className=\"w-3 h-3\" />\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* 3. VIRTUAL CLASSROOM LIVING SCENE: MISS NOUR & THE CHALKBOARD */}\n      <div className=\"relative bg-linear-to-b from-indigo-950 via-slate-900 to-indigo-950 rounded-3xl p-3 sm:p-4 text-white shadow-xl border border-indigo-800/80 overflow-hidden\">\n        {/* Room Classroom Wall Lighting Effect */}\n        <div className=\"absolute top-0 inset-x-0 h-24 bg-linear-to-b from-amber-400/10 to-transparent pointer-events-none\" />\n\n        {/* Teacher Speech Dialogue Bubble */}\n        <div className=\"relative z-20 mb-3 animate-in slide-in-from-top-2 duration-300\">\n          <div className=\"bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-800/95 backdrop-blur-md rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-lg border border-indigo-200/80 dark:border-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-start gap-2.5\">\n            <div className=\"shrink-0 mt-0.5\">\n              <span className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full inline-block ${isSpeaking ? 'bg-emerald-500 animate-ping' : 'bg-indigo-400'}`} />\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"flex-1\">\n              <p className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold leading-relaxed\">{teacherSpeech}</p>\n              {isSpeaking && (\n                <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 font-bold\">\n                  <span className=\"flex items-center gap-0.5\">\n                    <span className=\"w-1 h-2 bg-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-400 animate-pulse rounded-full\" />\n                    <span className=\"w-1 h-3.5 bg-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-400 animate-pulse delay-75 rounded-full\" />\n                    <span className=\"w-1 h-2 bg-indigo-600 dark:bg-indigo-400 animate-pulse delay-150 rounded-full\" />\n                  </span>\n                  <span>{isArabic ? 'مس نور تتحدث بصوت طبيعي...' : 'Miss Nour is speaking...'}</span>\n                </div>\n              )}\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0\">\n              {isSpeaking ? (\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={handleStopSpeaking}\n                  className=\"p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-950 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-300 transition-transform active:scale-95 cursor-pointer\"\n                  title={isArabic ? 'إيقاف الصوت' : 'Stop Voice'}\n                >\n                  <Square className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-current\" />\n                </button>\n              ) : (\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={() => speakText(teacherSpeech, 'talking')}\n                  className=\"p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-slate-700 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300 transition-transform active:scale-95 cursor-pointer\"\n                  title={isArabic ? 'استمعي لمس نور مجدداً' : 'Replay Voice'}\n                >\n                  <RotateCcw className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n                </button>\n              )}\n            </div>\n          </div>\n          {/* Bubble Pointer triangle */}\n          <div className=\"w-3 h-3 bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-800/95 rotate-45 transform origin-top-left ml-8 -mt-1 border-r border-b border-indigo-200/80 dark:border-slate-700\" />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Miss Nour Character Avatar & Interactive Chalkboard */}\n        <div className=\"relative z-10 flex items-end justify-between gap-2 pt-1\">\n          {/* Miss Nour Living Animated Avatar */}\n          <div\n            onClick={handleNourTap}\n            className=\"flex flex-col items-center cursor-pointer group shrink-0\"\n            title={isArabic ? 'اضغطي على مس نور لتتحدث معكِ!' : 'Tap Miss Nour to chat!'}\n          >\n            <div className=\"relative\">\n              <NourCharacter\n                state={nourState}\n                outfit={currentOutfit}\n                size=\"md\"\n                className=\"transform transition-transform group-hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 drop-shadow-2xl\"\n              />\n              {/* Sound waves when speaking */}\n              {isSpeaking && (\n                <div className=\"absolute -top-2 right-1 flex items-center gap-0.5 bg-amber-400 text-amber-950 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[9px] font-black shadow-xs animate-bounce\">\n                  <span>صوت</span>\n                  <span className=\"w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-950 animate-ping\" />\n                </div>\n              )}\n            </div>\n            <span className=\"text-[10px] font-black text-amber-300 mt-1 bg-black/50 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-amber-300/30\">\n              {isArabic ? 'المعلمة نور 🌟' : 'Miss Nour 🌟'}\n            </span>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Interactive Pedagogical Chalkboard */}\n          <div className=\"flex-1 bg-emerald-950/95 border-4 border-amber-800 rounded-2xl p-2.5 sm:p-3 shadow-inner text-emerald-100 flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[210px] relative overflow-hidden\">\n            {/* Wooden Chalkboard Frame Details */}\n            <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between border-b border-emerald-800/80 pb-1.5 mb-2 text-[10px] font-bold\">\n              <span className=\"text-amber-300 flex items-center gap-1 font-mono\">\n                <span>📝 سبورة الدرس:</span>\n                <span className=\"truncate max-w-[130px]\">{currentLesson.sourceRef.bookAr}</span>\n              </span>\n              <span className=\"text-emerald-400 font-mono\">ص. {currentLesson.sourceRef.page || 1}</span>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Blackboard Dynamic Content */}\n            <div className=\"space-y-1.5 min-h-[90px]\">\n              <h3 className=\"text-xs font-black text-amber-200\">\n                «{isArabic ? currentLesson.titleAr : currentLesson.titleEn}»\n              </h3>\n              <p className=\"text-[11px] text-emerald-200/90 leading-relaxed font-medium line-clamp-3\">\n                {currentLesson.readingText\n                  ? currentLesson.readingText.slice(0, 180) + '...'\n                  : currentLesson.objectives[0] || 'درس مقرر من كتب وزارة التربية والتعليم المصرية.'}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Chalkboard Quick Action Buttons */}\n            <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 pt-2 mt-auto border-t border-emerald-800/60\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => {\n                  soundEffects.playPop();\n                  setIsFullStageOpen(true);\n                }}\n                className=\"py-1.5 px-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-300 text-slate-950 font-black text-[11px] shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer\"\n              >\n                <Play className=\"w-3 h-3 fill-current\" />\n                <span>{isArabic ? 'المسرح الحي 🎭' : 'Live Stage 🎭'}</span>\n              </button>\n\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => {\n                  soundEffects.playPop();\n                  setIsStudyModalOpen(true);\n                }}\n                className=\"py-1.5 px-2 rounded-xl bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white font-black text-[11px] border border-white/20 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer\"\n              >\n                <BookOpen className=\"w-3 h-3\" />\n                <span>{isArabic ? 'كتاب الوزارة 📖' : 'Textbook 📖'}</span>\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Teacher Outfit Wardrobe Chips */}\n        <div className=\"mt-3 pt-2 border-t border-indigo-800/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-indigo-200 flex-wrap gap-1\">\n          <span className=\"flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-amber-300 text-[10px]\">\n            <Shirt className=\"w-3 h-3\" />\n            <span>{isArabic ? 'زي المعلمة:' : \"Outfit:\"}</span>\n          </span>\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap\">\n            {[\n              { id: 'arabic' as SubjectOutfit, label: 'عربي 📜' },\n              { id: 'math' as SubjectOutfit, label: 'رياضيات 📐' },\n              { id: 'science' as SubjectOutfit, label: 'علوم 🔬' },\n              { id: 'english' as SubjectOutfit, label: 'إنجليزي 🇬🇧' },\n              { id: 'social_studies' as SubjectOutfit, label: 'دراسات 🧭' },\n              { id: 'islamic' as SubjectOutfit, label: 'دين 🕌' },\n            ].map((outfit) => (\n              <button\n                key={outfit.id}\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => {\n                  soundEffects.playPop();\n                  setCurrentOutfit(outfit.id);\n                  const msg = isArabic\n                    ? `غيرت زي مس نور لمادة ${outfit.label.split(' ')[0]}! جاهزة يا ${studentName}؟`\n                    : `Switched outfit for ${outfit.label}! Ready, ${studentName}?`;\n                  speakText(msg, 'excited');\n                }}\n                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${\n                  currentOutfit === outfit.id\n                    ? 'bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 shadow-xs'\n                    : 'bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-indigo-100'\n                }`}\n              >\n                {outfit.label}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* 4. MAIN CLASSROOM STATIONS SELECTOR TABS */}\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-5 gap-1 p-1 bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-slate-800/90 rounded-2xl\">\n        {[\n          { id: 'diagnostic', labelAr: '1. التشخيص', labelEn: '1. Diagnosis', icon: '🩺' },\n          { id: 'chalkboard', labelAr: '2. الشرح الموجه', labelEn: '2. Teaching', icon: '👩‍🏫' },\n          { id: 'recheck', labelAr: '3. فحص الإتقان', labelEn: '3. Re-Check', icon: '🎯' },\n          { id: 'quiz', labelAr: '4. تمارين الوزارة', labelEn: '4. Exercises', icon: '⭐' },\n          { id: 'ask', labelAr: '5. اسألي نور', labelEn: '5. Ask Nour', icon: '💬' },\n        ].map((tab) => {\n          const isActive = activeStation === tab.id;\n          return (\n            <button\n              key={tab.id}\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => {\n                soundEffects.playPop();\n                setActiveStation(tab.id as any);\n              }}\n              className={`py-2 px-0.5 rounded-xl text-center transition-all flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 cursor-pointer ${\n                isActive\n                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md font-black scale-[1.02]'\n                  : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-white/60 dark:hover:bg-slate-700/60 font-bold'\n              }`}\n            >\n              <span className=\"text-base\">{tab.icon}</span>\n              <span className=\"text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] leading-tight truncate\">\n                {isArabic ? tab.labelAr : tab.labelEn}\n              </span>\n            </button>\n          );\n        })}\n      </div>\n\n      {/* 5. STATION CONTENT VIEW */}\n\n      {/* STATION 0: PROACTIVE DIAGNOSTIC STATION (DIAGNOSE BEFORE TEACHING) */}\n      {activeStation === 'diagnostic' && (\n        <div className=\"p-3.5 sm:p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-3.5\">\n          {/* Header */}\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n              <span className=\"text-xl\">🩺</span>\n              <div>\n                <h3 className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n                  {isArabic ? 'محطة التشخيص الاستكشافي' : 'Exploratory Diagnostic Station'}\n                </h3>\n                <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400\">\n                  {isArabic\n                    ? 'نفحص استيعابك أولاً لتحديد الأسلوب الأنسب للشرح'\n                    : 'Diagnosing understanding before detailed explanation'}\n                </p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n\n            <span className=\"px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-950 text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-300\">\n              {teacherContext.targetLesson?.subjectNameAr || currentLesson.subjectNameAr}\n            </span>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* School Context Banner */}\n          <div className=\"p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50/70 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs\">\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0\">\n              <span className=\"text-base shrink-0\">🏫</span>\n              <span className=\"text-[11px] font-bold text-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-200 truncate\">\n                {teacherContext.recommendedReason}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n            {teacherContext.masteryState && (\n              <span className=\"shrink-0 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700\">\n                {teacherContext.masteryState.compositeLabel}\n              </span>\n            )}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Diagnostic Question Card */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-3\">\n            <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 space-y-1\">\n              <span className=\"text-[10px] font-black text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 block\">\n                {isArabic ? 'سؤال استكشافي من مس نور:' : 'Diagnostic Question from Miss Nour:'}\n              </span>\n              <h4 className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 leading-relaxed\">\n                {isArabic\n                  ? teacherContext.diagnosticQuestion.promptAr\n                  : isFrench\n                  ? teacherContext.diagnosticQuestion.promptFr\n                  : teacherContext.diagnosticQuestion.promptEn}\n              </h4>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Diagnostic Options */}\n            <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n              {teacherContext.diagnosticQuestion.options.map((opt, oIdx) => {\n                const isSelected = selectedDiagnosticIndex === oIdx;\n                const isCorrect = opt.isCorrect;\n                const showFeedback = selectedDiagnosticIndex !== null;\n\n                return (\n                  <button\n                    key={oIdx}\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    disabled={selectedDiagnosticIndex !== null}\n                    onClick={() => handleSelectDiagnosticOption(oIdx)}\n                    className={`w-full p-3 rounded-2xl border text-xs font-bold text-right rtl:text-right ltr:text-left transition-all flex items-start justify-between gap-2 cursor-pointer ${\n                      showFeedback\n                        ? isCorrect\n                          ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-500 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200'\n                          : isSelected\n                          ? 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 border-rose-500 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200'\n                          : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 opacity-60'\n                        : 'bg-slate-50 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'\n                    }`}\n                  >\n                    <span className=\"leading-relaxed\">\n                      {isArabic ? opt.textAr : isFrench ? opt.textFr : opt.textEn}\n                    </span>\n                    {showFeedback && (\n                      <span className=\"shrink-0 mt-0.5\">\n                        {isCorrect ? (\n                          <CheckCircle2 className=\"w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600\" />\n                        ) : isSelected ? (\n                          <XCircle className=\"w-4 h-4 text-rose-600\" />\n                        ) : null}\n                      </span>\n                    )}\n                  </button>\n                );\n              })}\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Diagnostic Evaluation & Thinking Input (MAKE AMINA EXPLAIN HER THINKING) */}\n            {selectedDiagnosticIndex !== null && (\n              <div className=\"pt-2 animate-in fade-in duration-200 space-y-3\">\n                {/* Pedagogical Diagnosis Notice */}\n                {(() => {\n                  const opt = teacherContext.diagnosticQuestion.options[selectedDiagnosticIndex];\n                  return (\n                    <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 space-y-1.5\">\n                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-black text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-200\">\n                        <Lightbulb className=\"w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400\" />\n                        <span>{isArabic ? 'تشخيص المعلمة نور الأولي 💡' : 'Miss Nour\\'s Initial Diagnosis 💡'}</span>\n                      </div>\n                      <p className=\"text-xs text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-200 leading-relaxed font-medium\">\n                        {isArabic ? opt.diagnosisExplanationAr : isFrench ? opt.diagnosisExplanationFr : opt.diagnosisExplanationEn}\n                      </p>\n                    </div>\n                  );\n                })()}\n\n                {/* Make Amina Explain Her Thinking */}\n                <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 space-y-2\">\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n                    <span className=\"text-xs font-black text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-200 flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                      <span>🎙️</span>\n                      <span>\n                        {isArabic\n                          ? teacherContext.diagnosticQuestion.thinkingPromptAr\n                          : teacherContext.diagnosticQuestion.thinkingPromptEn}\n                      </span>\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                    <input\n                      type=\"text\"\n                      value={studentThinkingInput}\n                      onChange={(e) => setStudentThinkingInput(e.target.value)}\n                      placeholder={\n                        isArabic\n                          ? 'اكتبي أو تحدثي بصوتك: مثلاً فكرت في كذا علشان...'\n                          : 'Type or speak: e.g. I thought about...'\n                      }\n                      className=\"flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-700 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-hidden\"\n                    />\n                    <VoiceInputControl\n                      onTranscriptConfirmed={(text: string) => {\n                        setStudentThinkingInput((prev) => (prev ? `${prev} ${text}` : text));\n                      }}\n                    />\n                  </div>\n\n                  {studentThinkingInput && (\n                    <div className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-800/70 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900 text-[11px] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300\">\n                      <span className=\"font-bold text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300\">\n                        {isArabic ? 'طريقة تفكير أمينة المسجلة:' : 'Amina\\'s reasoning:'}{' '}\n                      </span>\n                      <span>{studentThinkingInput}</span>\n                    </div>\n                  )}\n\n                  {/* Trigger reasoning analysis */}\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={handleAnalyzeThinking}\n                    className=\"w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-300 text-slate-950 font-black text-xs shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer\"\n                  >\n                    <span>💡</span>\n                    <span>{isArabic ? 'تحليل طريقة تفكيرك واختيار الاستراتيجية' : 'Analyze Reasoning & Pick Strategy'}</span>\n                  </button>\n                </div>\n\n                {/* Reasoning Analysis Feedback Card */}\n                {reasoningAnalysis && (\n                  <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/40 border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-800 space-y-1.5 animate-in fade-in\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n                      <span className=\"text-xs font-black text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200 flex items-center gap-1\">\n                        <span>🔍</span>\n                        <span>{isArabic ? 'تصنيف طريقة التفكير:' : 'Reasoning Classification:'}</span>\n                      </span>\n                      <span className=\"px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-purple-200/80 dark:bg-purple-900 text-purple-950 dark:text-purple-100\">\n                        {getReasoningLabel(reasoningAnalysis.category, language)}\n                      </span>\n                    </div>\n                    <p className=\"text-xs text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-200 leading-relaxed font-medium\">\n                      {isArabic ? reasoningAnalysis.explanationAr : reasoningAnalysis.explanationEn}\n                    </p>\n                    <div className=\"pt-1 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-purple-800 dark:text-purple-300 font-bold\">\n                      <span>🎯 {isArabic ? 'الانتقال للشرح الموجه على السبورة 👩‍🏫'\n                      : 'Advance to Targeted Teaching on Chalkboard 👩‍🏫'}\n                  </span>\n                  <ArrowRight className=\"w-4 h-4 rtl:rotate-180\" />\n                </button>\n              </div>\n            )}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* STATION 1: TARGETED INTERACTIVE EXPLANATION STATION */}\n      {activeStation === 'chalkboard' && (\n        <div className=\"p-3.5 sm:p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-3\">\n          {/* Strategy Indicator Banner */}\n          <div className=\"p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50/80 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs\">\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0\">\n              <span className=\"text-base shrink-0\">🎯</span>\n              <span className=\"font-bold text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-200 truncate\">\n                {isArabic ? 'استراتيجية مس نور الموجهة:' : 'Miss Nour\\'s Targeted Strategy:'}\n              </span>\n              <span className=\"px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black bg-indigo-600 text-white shrink-0\">\n                {getStrategyLabel(chosenTeachingStrategy, language)}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setActiveStation('diagnostic')}\n              className=\"text-[10px] font-bold text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 hover:underline shrink-0 cursor-pointer\"\n            >\n              {isArabic ? 'إعادة التشخيص 🩺' : 'Re-diagnose 🩺'}\n            </button>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* TARGETED PEDAGOGICAL INTERVENTION CARD (TEACH SPECIFICALLY FOR THE DIAGNOSED NEED) */}\n          {(() => {\n            const targeted = targetedTeachingContent || teacherContext.targetedTeaching;\n            return (\n              <div className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-linear-to-br from-indigo-50/90 via-amber-50/40 to-purple-50/70 dark:from-slate-750 dark:via-slate-800 dark:to-slate-750 border-2 border-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-700 space-y-2.5\">\n                <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n                  <span className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-200 flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                    <span>💡</span>\n                    <span>{isArabic ? targeted.headlineAr : targeted.headlineEn}</span>\n                  </span>\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => speakText(targeted.coreExplanationAr, 'talking')}\n                    className=\"px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 text-white font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center gap-1 shadow-xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95\"\n                  >\n                    <Volume2 className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n                    <span>{isArabic ? 'استمعي' : 'Listen'}</span>\n                  </button>\n                </div>\n\n                <p className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap\">\n                  {isArabic ? targeted.coreExplanationAr : targeted.coreExplanationEn}\n                </p>\n\n                {/* Contrast / Analogy Model */}\n                <div className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-850 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-200 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed\">\n                  {isArabic ? targeted.contrastOrAnalogyAr : targeted.contrastOrAnalogyEn}\n                </div>\n\n                {/* Golden Rule Card */}\n                <div className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-2 shadow-xs\">\n                  <span>🌟 {isArabic ?
