'الرياضيات' : 'Mathematics',\n    conceptNameAr: 'ضرب الكسور الاعتيادية',\n    conceptNameEn: 'Multiplying Fractions',\n    rationaleAr: 'تثبيت تحويل الأعداد الكسرية قبل الضرب سيمنحك سهولة فائقة في حل مسائل الأسبوع القادم.',\n    rationaleEn: 'Practicing fraction conversion prior to multiplication will make upcoming lessons a breeze.',\n  };\n\n  if (weakConcepts.length > 0) {\n    const focusTarget = weakConcepts[0];\n    recommendedFocus = {\n      subject: focusTarget.subject,\n      conceptNameAr: focusTarget.nameAr,\n      conceptNameEn: focusTarget.nameEn,\n      rationaleAr: `جلسة واحدة مدتها 10 دقائق لمفهوم (${focusTarget.nameAr}) كافية لاستعادة الثقة التامة.`,\n      rationaleEn: `A single 10-minute refresh for (${focusTarget.nameEn}) is enough to restore complete confidence.`,\n    };\n  } else if (repeatedErrors.length > 0) {\n    const errorTarget = repeatedErrors[0];\n    recommendedFocus = {\n      subject: errorTarget.subject,\n      conceptNameAr: errorTarget.nameAr,\n      conceptNameEn: errorTarget.nameEn,\n      rationaleAr: `مراجعة لطيفة للملاحظات الأساسية في (${errorTarget.nameAr}) لتلافي تكرار الأخطاء البسيطة.`,\n      rationaleEn: `A gentle review of key points in (${errorTarget.nameEn}) to prevent minor calculation slips.`,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 7. Non-guilt tone messages\n  const toneMessageAr = strongConcepts.length > 0\n    ? `أسبوع مليء بالخطوات الثابتة يا ${student.name}! أنجزت ${strongConcepts.length} مفاهيم بتفوق، ووقت دراستك (${timeSpentMinutes} دقيقة) يعكس التزامك الرائع دون أي ضغوط.`\n    : `أسبوع إيجابي يا ${student.name}! خطوت خطوات حقيقية في ترسيخ معلومات المدرسة، وكل دقيقة بذلتها تثري حصيلتك المعرفية بهدوء.`;\n\n  const toneMessageEn = strongConcepts.length > 0\n    ? `A week of solid accomplishments, ${student.name}! You mastered ${strongConcepts.length} concepts smoothly, and your study time (${timeSpentMinutes} min) reflects great focus without pressure.`\n    : `A positive week, ${student.name}! You made tangible progress cementing school topics at a healthy, sustainable pace.`;\n\n  return {\n    id: `wk_rev_${student.id}_${weekStartDate}`,\n    studentId: student.id,\n    weekStartDate,\n    weekEndDate,\n    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    lessonsCovered,\n    homeworkCompletion: {\n      completed: hwCompleted,\n      total: hwTotal,\n      percentage: hwPercentage,\n    },\n    quizPerformanceTrend: {\n      averageScore: averageQuizScore,\n      trend,\n      detailsAr,\n      detailsEn,\n    },\n    repeatedErrors,\n    weakConcepts,\n    strongConcepts,\n    savedContentCount: savedItems.length,\n    timeSpentMinutes,\n    formatEffectiveness,\n    recommendedFocus,\n    toneMessageAr,\n    toneMessageEn,\n  };\n}\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport {\n  Student,\n  DayRecord,\n  MasteryRecord,\n  Mission,\n  HomeworkItem,\n  SavedItem,\n  WeeklyReview,\n  LessonSummaryItem,\n  RepeatedErrorItem,\n  ConceptMasterySummaryItem,\n  ModalityEffectiveness,\n  Language,\n} from '../../types';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport { formatMasteryView } from '../mastery/masteryEngine';\nimport { localDateStr } from '../../utils/time';\n\nexport interface GenerateWeeklyReviewParams {\n  student: Student;\n  dayRecords: DayRecord[];\n  masteryRecords: Record<string, MasteryRecord>;\n  completedMissions: Mission[];\n  homeworkItems: HomeworkItem[];\n  savedItems?: SavedItem[];\n  language?: Language;\n  customStartDate?: string;\n  customEndDate?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Pure TypeScript WeeklyReview generator adhering strictly to the non-guilt, specific wins tone rules.\n */\nexport function generateWeeklyReview(params: GenerateWeeklyReviewParams): WeeklyReview {\n  const {\n    student,\n    dayRecords,\n    masteryRecords,\n    completedMissions,\n    homeworkItems,\n    savedItems = [],\n    language = 'ar',\n    customStartDate,\n    customEndDate,\n  } = params;\n\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n  const now = new Date();\n  const weekEndDate = customEndDate || localDateStr(now);\n  const weekStartObj = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000);\n  const weekStartDate = customStartDate || localDateStr(weekStartObj);\n\n  const flatConcepts = curriculumService.getFlatConcepts();\n  const conceptMap = new Map(flatConcepts.map((c) => [c.id, c]));\n\n  // 1. Lessons covered this week\n  const lessonsCovered: LessonSummaryItem[] = [];\n  const seenLessons = new Set<string>();\n\n  dayRecords.forEach((record) => {\n    // Only records within this week range\n    if (record.date >= weekStartDate && record.date <= weekEndDate) {\n      record.lessonsCovered.forEach((l) => {\n        const key = `${l.subject}_${l.topic || ''}`;\n        if (!seenLessons.has(key)) {\n          seenLessons.add(key);\n          lessonsCovered.push({\n            subject: l.subject,\n            topic: l.topic,\n            date: record.date,\n          });\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  // No recorded lessons this week: report the empty state truthfully instead of\n  // inventing demo lessons that the student never studied.\n\n  // 2. Homework completion\n  const recentHomework = homeworkItems.filter((hw) => !hw.date || (hw.date >= weekStartDate && hw.date <= weekEndDate));\n  const hwTotal = recentHomework.length > 0 ? recentHomework.length : Math.max(1, homeworkItems.length);\n  const hwCompleted = recentHomework.length > 0\n    ? recentHomework.filter((hw) => hw.status === 'completed').length\n    : homeworkItems.filter((hw) => hw.status === 'completed').length;\n\n  const hwPercentage = Math.round((hwCompleted / Math.max(1, hwTotal)) * 100);\n\n  // 3. Quiz performance trend & all evidence analysis\n  let totalScoreSum = 0;\n  let quizEvidenceCount = 0;\n  const modalityStats: Record<string, { total: number; fullCorrect: number }> = {\n    quiz: { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 },\n    practice: { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 },\n    game: { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 },\n    reel_check: { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 },\n    homework: { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 },\n  };\n\n  const repeatedErrors: RepeatedErrorItem[] = [];\n  const weakConcepts: ConceptMasterySummaryItem[] = [];\n  const strongConcepts: ConceptMasterySummaryItem[] = [];\n\n  Object.values(masteryRecords).forEach((rec) => {\n    const meta = conceptMap.get(rec.conceptId);\n    if (!meta) return;\n\n    const subjName = meta.subjectId === 'subj_math'\n      ? (isAr ? 'الرياضيات' : 'Mathematics')\n      : meta.subjectId === 'subj_arabic'\n      ? (isAr ? 'اللغة العربية' : 'Arabic')\n      : (isAr ? 'العلوم' : 'Science');\n\n    // Tally evidence\n    const recentEvidence = rec.evidenceLog.slice(-5);\n    const wrongEvidence = recentEvidence.filter((e) => e.correctness === 'wrong');\n    if (wrongEvidence.length >= 2) {\n      repeatedErrors.push({\n        conceptId: rec.conceptId,\n        nameAr: meta.nameAr,\n        nameEn: meta.nameEn,\n        subject: subjName,\n        errorCount: wrongEvidence.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Collect weak concepts (needs_review or score < 0.6)\n    const view = formatMasteryView(rec, language);\n    if (view.threshold === 'needs_review' || (rec.score < 0.65 && rec.evidenceCount > 0)) {\n      weakConcepts.push({\n        conceptId: rec.conceptId,\n        nameAr: meta.nameAr,\n        nameEn: meta.nameEn,\n        subject: subjName,\n        score: rec.score,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Collect strong concepts (mastered)\n    if (rec.score >= 0.75 && rec.confidence >= 0.35) {\n      strongConcepts.push({\n        conceptId: rec.conceptId,\n        nameAr: meta.nameAr,\n        nameEn: meta.nameEn,\n        subject: subjName,\n        score: rec.score,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Modality breakdown\n    rec.evidenceLog.forEach((ev) => {\n      const mod = ev.modality || 'quiz';\n      if (!modalityStats[mod]) {\n        modalityStats[mod] = { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 };\n      }\n      modalityStats[mod].total++;\n      if (ev.correctness === 'full') {\n        modalityStats[mod].fullCorrect++;\n      }\n      if (mod === 'quiz') {\n        totalScoreSum += ev.correctness === 'full' ? 1 : ev.correctness === 'partial' ? 0.6 : 0.2;\n        quizEvidenceCount++;\n      }\n    });\n  });\n\n  // Quiz trend details\n  const averageQuizScore = quizEvidenceCount > 0 ? Math.round((totalScoreSum / quizEvidenceCount) * 100) : 84;\n  const trend: 'improving' | 'steady' | 'needs_boost' =\n    averageQuizScore >= 80 ? 'improving' : averageQuizScore >= 65 ? 'steady' : 'needs_boost';\n\n  const detailsAr = trend === 'improving'\n    ? `أداء متصاعد ومطمئن في الأسئلة القصيرة بمعدل استيعاب يبلغ ${averageQuizScore}٪.`\n    : trend === 'steady'\n    ? `أداء مستقر ومتوازن في التقييمات السريعة بنسبة ${averageQuizScore}٪.`\n    : `فرصة طيبة لمزيد من التمرن في جو مريح لتحسين الدقة (${averageQuizScore}٪).`;\n\n  const detailsEn = trend === 'improving'\n    ? `Ascending and confident performance on quick checks with ${averageQuizScore}% retention rate.`\n    : trend === 'steady'\n    ? `Consistent and steady performance across quizzes with ${averageQuizScore}% success.`\n    : `A gentle opportunity to practice with simplified steps (${averageQuizScore}%).`;\n\n  // 4. Time spent\n  const timeSpentMinutes = completedMissions.reduce((acc, m) => acc + (m.estimatedMinutes || 10), 0) || 75;\n\n  // 5. Format effectiveness\n  const modalityLabels: Record<string, { ar: string; en: string }> = {\n    game: { ar: 'الألعاب والتحديات التفاعلية', en: 'Interactive Games' },\n    practice: { ar: 'التمارين التدريجية مع الرفيق', en: 'Guided Practice' },\n    reel_check: { ar: 'المقاطع التعليمية السريعة', en: 'Micro-Lessons & Reels' },\n    quiz: { ar: 'الاختبارات الذاتية القصيرة', en: 'Self-Check Quizzes' },\n    homework: { ar: 'تطبيق الواجبات المدرسية', en: 'Homework Tasks' },\n  };\n\n  const formatEffectiveness: ModalityEffectiveness[] = Object.entries(modalityStats)\n    .filter(([_, stats]) => stats.total > 0)\n    .map(([mod, stats]) => {\n      const retentionScore = Math.round((stats.fullCorrect / stats.total) * 100) / 100;\n      const meta = modalityLabels[mod] || { ar: mod, en: mod };\n      return {\n        modality: mod as ModalityEffectiveness['modality'],\n        labelAr: meta.ar,\n        labelEn: meta.en,\n        retentionScore,\n        sampleCount: stats.total,\n        descriptionAr: retentionScore >= 0.8\n          ? `أعلى معدل استيعاب وحفظ للمفاهيم (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}٪).`\n          : `معدل استيعاب متوسط (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}٪) يزداد مع الممارسة.`,\n        descriptionEn: retentionScore >= 0.8\n          ? `Highest retention and comprehension rate (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}%).`\n          : `Moderate retention (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}%) improves with frequency.`,\n      };\n    })\n    .sort((a, b) => b.retentionScore - a.retentionScore);\n\n  // If empty, add standard pleasant modalities\n  if (formatEffectiveness.length === 0) {\n    formatEffectiveness.push(\n      {\n        modality: 'game',\n        labelAr: 'الألعاب والتحديات التفاعلية',\n        labelEn: 'Interactive Games',\n        retentionScore: 0.92,\n        sampleCount: 5,\n        descriptionAr: 'تحقق أعلى تركيز واحتفاظ ذهني بالمعلومات.',\n        descriptionEn: 'Yields highest retention and conceptual engagement.',\n      },\n      {\n        modality: 'practice',\n        labelAr: 'التمارين التدريجية مع الرفيق',\n        labelEn: 'Guided Practice',\n        retentionScore: 0.85,\n        sampleCount: 6,\n        descriptionAr: 'تثبيت ممتاز للمسائل خطوة بخطوة.',\n        descriptionEn: 'Excellent step-by-step problem reinforcement.',\n      }\n    );\n  }\n\n  // 6. One recommended focus for next week\n  let recommendedFocus = {\n    subject: isAr ? 'الرياضيات' : 'Mathematics',\n    conceptNameAr: 'ضرب الكسور الاعتيادية',\n    conceptNameEn: 'Multiplying Fractions',\n    rationaleAr: 'تثبيت تحويل الأعداد الكسرية قبل الضرب سيمنحك سهولة فائقة في حل مسائل الأسبوع القادم.',\n    rationaleEn: 'Practicing fraction conversion prior to multiplication will make upcoming lessons a breeze.',\n  };\n\n  if (weakConcepts.length > 0) {\n    const focusTarget = weakConcepts[0];\n    recommendedFocus = {\n      subject: focusTarget.subject,\n      conceptNameAr: focusTarget.nameAr,\n      conceptNameEn: focusTarget.nameEn,\n      rationaleAr: `جلسة واحدة مدتها 10 دقائق لمفهوم (${focusTarget.nameAr}) كافية لاستعادة الثقة التامة.`,\n      rationaleEn: `A single 10-minute refresh for (${focusTarget.nameEn}) is enough to restore complete confidence.`,\n    };\n  } else if (repeatedErrors.length > 0) {\n    const errorTarget = repeatedErrors[0];\n    recommendedFocus = {\n      subject: errorTarget.subject,\n      conceptNameAr: errorTarget.nameAr,\n      conceptNameEn: errorTarget.nameEn,\n      rationaleAr: `مراجعة لطيفة للملاحظات الأساسية في (${errorTarget.nameAr}) لتلافي تكرار الأخطاء البسيطة.`,\n      rationaleEn: `A gentle review of key points in (${errorTarget.nameEn}) to prevent minor calculation slips.`,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 7. Non-guilt tone messages\n  const toneMessageAr = strongConcepts.length > 0\n    ? `أسبوع مليء بالخطوات الثابتة يا ${student.name}! أنجزت ${strongConcepts.length} مفاهيم بتفوق، ووقت دراستك (${timeSpentMinutes} دقيقة) يعكس التزامك الرائع دون أي ضغوط.`\n    : `أسبوع إيجابي يا ${student.name}! خطوت خطوات حقيقية في ترسيخ معلومات المدرسة، وكل دقيقة بذلتها تثري حصيلتك المعرفية بهدوء.`;\n\n  const toneMessageEn = strongConcepts.length > 0\n    ? `A week of solid accomplishments, ${student.name}! Lessons covered this week\n  const lessonsCovered: LessonSummaryItem[] = [];\n  const seenLessons = new Set<string>();\n\n  dayRecords.forEach((record) => {\n    // Only records within this week range\n    if (record.date >= weekStartDate && record.date <= weekEndDate) {\n      record.lessonsCovered.forEach((l) => {\n        const key = `${l.subject}_${l.topic || ''}`;\n        if (!seenLessons.has(key)) {\n          seenLessons.add(key);\n          lessonsCovered.push({\n            subject: l.subject,\n            topic: l.topic,\n            date: record.date,\n          });\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  // No recorded lessons this week: report the empty state truthfully instead of\n  // inventing demo lessons that the student never studied.\n\n  // 2. Homework completion\n  const recentHomework = homeworkItems.filter((hw) => !hw.date || (hw.date >= weekStartDate && hw.date <= weekEndDate));\n  const hwTotal = recentHomework.length > 0 ? recentHomework.length : Math.max(1, homeworkItems.length);\n  const hwCompleted = recentHomework.length > 0\n    ? recentHomework.filter((hw) => hw.status === 'completed').length\n    : homeworkItems.filter((hw) => hw.status === 'completed').length;\n\n  const hwPercentage = Math.round((hwCompleted / Math.max(1, hwTotal)) * 100);\n\n  // 3. Quiz performance trend & all evidence analysis\n  let totalScoreSum = 0;\n  let quizEvidenceCount = 0;\n  const modalityStats: Record<string, { total: number; fullCorrect: number }> = {\n    quiz: { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 },\n    practice: { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 },\n    game: { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 },\n    reel_check: { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 },\n    homework: { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 },\n  };\n\n  const repeatedErrors: RepeatedErrorItem[] = [];\n  const weakConcepts: ConceptMasterySummaryItem[] = [];\n  const strongConcepts: ConceptMasterySummaryItem[] = [];\n\n  Object.values(masteryRecords).forEach((rec) => {\n    const meta = conceptMap.get(rec.conceptId);\n    if (!meta) return;\n\n    const subjName = meta.subjectId === 'subj_math'\n      ? (isAr ? 'الرياضيات' : 'Mathematics')\n      : meta.subjectId === 'subj_arabic'\n      ? (isAr ? 'اللغة العربية' : 'Arabic')\n      : (isAr ? 'العلوم' : 'Science');\n\n    // Tally evidence\n    const recentEvidence = rec.evidenceLog.slice(-5);\n    const wrongEvidence = recentEvidence.filter((e) => e.correctness === 'wrong');\n    if (wrongEvidence.length >= 2) {\n      repeatedErrors.push({\n        conceptId: rec.conceptId,\n        nameAr: meta.nameAr,\n        nameEn: meta.nameEn,\n        subject: subjName,\n        errorCount: wrongEvidence.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Collect weak concepts (needs_review or score < 0.6)\n    const view = formatMasteryView(rec, language);\n    if (view.threshold === 'needs_review' || (rec.score < 0.65 && rec.evidenceCount > 0)) {\n      weakConcepts.push({\n        conceptId: rec.conceptId,\n        nameAr: meta.nameAr,\n        nameEn: meta.nameEn,\n        subject: subjName,\n        score: rec.score,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Collect strong concepts (mastered)\n    if (rec.score >= 0.75 && rec.confidence >= 0.35) {\n      strongConcepts.push({\n        conceptId: rec.conceptId,\n        nameAr: meta.nameAr,\n        nameEn: meta.nameEn,\n        subject: subjName,\n        score: rec.score,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Modality breakdown\n    rec.evidenceLog.forEach((ev) => {\n      const mod = ev.modality || 'quiz';\n      if (!modalityStats[mod]) {\n        modalityStats[mod] = { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 };\n      }\n      modalityStats[mod].total++;\n      if (ev.correctness === 'full') {\n        modalityStats[mod].fullCorrect++;\n      }\n      if (mod === 'quiz') {\n        totalScoreSum += ev.correctness === 'full' ? 1 : ev.correctness === 'partial' ? 0.6 : 0.2;\n        quizEvidenceCount++;\n      }\n    });\n  });\n\n  // Quiz trend details — reported only from recorded quiz evidence; no invented score.\n  const hasQuizEvidence = quizEvidenceCount > 0;\n  const averageQuizScore = hasQuizEvidence ? Math.round((totalScoreSum / quizEvidenceCount) * 100) : 0;\n  const trend: 'improving' | 'steady' | 'needs_boost' | 'no_evidence' =\n    !hasQuizEvidence ? 'no_evidence' : averageQuizScore >= 80 ? 'improving' : averageQuizScore >= 65 ? 'steady' : 'needs_boost';\n\n  const detailsAr = trend === 'no_evidence'\n    ? 'لسه مفيش تقييمات مسجلة هذا الأسبوع؛ أول ما تحلي أسئلة الفهم هتظهر هنا.'\n    : trend === 'improving'\n    ? `أداء متصاعد ومطمئن في الأسئلة القصيرة بمعدل استيعاب يبلغ ${averageQuizScore}٪.`\n    : trend === 'steady'\n    ? `أداء مستقر ومتوازن في التقييمات السريعة بنسبة ${averageQuizScore}٪.`\n    : `فرصة طيبة لمزيد من التمرن في جو مريح لتحسين الدقة (${averageQuizScore}٪).`;\n\n  const detailsEn = trend === 'no_evidence'\n    ? 'No graded checks recorded this week yet; your comprehension trend will appear once you practise.'\n    : trend === 'improving'\n    ? `Ascending and confident performance on quick checks with ${averageQuizScore}% retention rate.`\n    : trend === 'steady'\n    ? `Consistent and steady performance across quizzes with ${averageQuizScore}% success.`\n    : `A gentle opportunity to practice with simplified steps (${averageQuizScore}%).`;\n\n  // 4. Time spent — sum of actual completed-mission time, never a placeholder.\n  const timeSpentMinutes = completedMissions.reduce((acc, m) => acc + (m.estimatedMinutes || 0), 0);\n\n  // 5. Format effectiveness\n  const modalityLabels: Record<string, { ar: string; en: string }> = {\n    game: { ar: 'الألعاب والتحديات التفاعلية', en: 'Interactive Games' },\n    practice: { ar: 'التمارين التدريجية مع الرفيق', en: 'Guided Practice' },\n    reel_check: { ar: 'المقاطع التعليمية السريعة', en: 'Micro-Lessons & Reels' },\n    quiz: { ar: 'الاختبارات الذاتية القصيرة', en: 'Self-Check Quizzes' },\n    homework: { ar: 'تطبيق الواجبات المدرسية', en: 'Homework Tasks' },\n  };\n\n  const formatEffectiveness: ModalityEffectiveness[] = Object.entries(modalityStats)\n    .filter(([_, stats]) => stats.total > 0)\n    .map(([mod, stats]) => {\n      const retentionScore = Math.round((stats.fullCorrect / stats.total) * 100) / 100;\n      const meta = modalityLabels[mod] || { ar: mod, en: mod };\n      return {\n        modality: mod as ModalityEffectiveness['modality'],\n        labelAr: meta.ar,\n        labelEn: meta.en,\n        retentionScore,\n        sampleCount: stats.total,\n        descriptionAr: retentionScore >= 0.8\n          ? `أعلى معدل استيعاب وحفظ للمفاهيم (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}٪).`\n          : `معدل استيعاب متوسط (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}٪) يزداد مع الممارسة.`,\n        descriptionEn: retentionScore >= 0.8\n          ? `Highest retention and comprehension rate (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}%).`\n          : `Moderate retention (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}%) improves with frequency.`,\n      };\n    })\n    .sort((a, b) => b.retentionScore - a.retentionScore);\n\n  // When there is no recorded evidence, report no modalities rather than inventing stats.\n\n  // 6. One recommended focus for next week\n  let recommendedFocus = {\n    subject: isAr ? 'الرياضيات' : 'Mathematics',\n    conceptNameAr: 'ضرب الكسور الاعتيادية',\n    conceptNameEn: 'Multiplying Fractions',\n    rationaleAr: 'تثبيت تحويل الأعداد الكسرية قبل الضرب سيمنحك سهولة فائقة في حل مسائل الأسبوع القادم.',\n    rationaleEn: 'Practicing fraction conversion prior to multiplication will make upcoming lessons a breeze.',\n  };\n\n  if (weakConcepts.length > 0) {\n    const focusTarget = weakConcepts[0];\n    recommendedFocus = {\n      subject: focusTarget.subject,\n      conceptNameAr: focusTarget.nameAr,\n      conceptNameEn: focusTarget.nameEn,\n      rationaleAr: `جلسة واحدة مدتها 10 دقائق لمفهوم (${focusTarget.nameAr}) كافية لاستعادة الثقة التامة.`,\n      rationaleEn: `A single 10-minute refresh for (${focusTarget.nameEn}) is enough to restore complete confidence.`,\n    };\n  } else if (repeatedErrors.length > 0) {\n    const errorTarget = repeatedErrors[0];\n    recommendedFocus = {\n      subject: errorTarget.subject,\n      conceptNameAr: errorTarget.nameAr,\n      conceptNameEn: errorTarget.nameEn,\n      rationaleAr: `مراجعة لطيفة للملاحظات الأساسية في (${errorTarget.nameAr}) لتلافي تكرار الأخطاء البسيطة.`,\n      rationaleEn: `A gentle review of key points in (${errorTarget.nameEn}) to prevent minor calculation slips.`,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 7. Lessons covered this week\n  const lessonsCovered: LessonSummaryItem[] = [];\n  const seenLessons = new Set<string>();\n\n  dayRecords.forEach((record) => {\n    // Only records within this week range\n    if (record.date >= weekStartDate && record.date <= weekEndDate) {\n      record.lessonsCovered.forEach((l) => {\n        const key = `${l.subject}_${l.topic || ''}`;\n        if (!seenLessons.has(key)) {\n          seenLessons.add(key);\n          lessonsCovered.push({\n            subject: l.subject,\n            topic: l.topic,\n            date: record.date,\n          });\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  });\n\n  // No recorded lessons this week: report the empty state truthfully instead of\n  // inventing demo lessons that the student never studied.\n\n  // 2. (isAr ? 'الرياضيات' : 'Mathematics')\n      : meta.subjectId === 'subj_arabic'\n      ? (isAr ? 'اللغة العربية' : 'Arabic')\n      : (isAr ? 'العلوم' : 'Science');\n\n    // Tally evidence\n    const recentEvidence = rec.evidenceLog.slice(-5);\n    const wrongEvidence = recentEvidence.filter((e) => e.correctness === 'wrong');\n    if (wrongEvidence.length >= 2) {\n      repeatedErrors.push({\n        conceptId: rec.conceptId,\n        nameAr: meta.nameAr,\n        nameEn: meta.nameEn,\n        subject: subjName,\n        errorCount: wrongEvidence.length,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Collect weak concepts (needs_review or score < 0.6)\n    const view = formatMasteryView(rec, language);\n    if (view.threshold === 'needs_review' || (rec.score < 0.65 && rec.evidenceCount > 0)) {\n      weakConcepts.push({\n        conceptId: rec.conceptId,\n        nameAr: meta.nameAr,\n        nameEn: meta.nameEn,\n        subject: subjName,\n        score: rec.score,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Collect strong concepts (mastered)\n    if (rec.score >= 0.75 && rec.confidence >= 0.35) {\n      strongConcepts.push({\n        conceptId: rec.conceptId,\n        nameAr: meta.nameAr,\n        nameEn: meta.nameEn,\n        subject: subjName,\n        score: rec.score,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Modality breakdown\n    rec.evidenceLog.forEach((ev) => {\n      const mod = ev.modality || 'quiz';\n      if (!modalityStats[mod]) {\n        modalityStats[mod] = { total: 0, fullCorrect: 0 };\n      }\n      modalityStats[mod].total++;\n      if (ev.correctness === 'full') {\n        modalityStats[mod].fullCorrect++;\n      }\n      if (mod === 'quiz') {\n        totalScoreSum += ev.correctness === 'full' ? 1 : ev.correctness === 'partial' ? 0.6 : 0.2;\n        quizEvidenceCount++;\n      }\n    });\n  });\n\n  // Quiz trend details — reported only from recorded quiz evidence; no invented score.\n  const hasQuizEvidence = quizEvidenceCount > 0;\n  const averageQuizScore = hasQuizEvidence ? Format effectiveness\n  const modalityLabels: Record<string, { ar: string; en: string }> = {\n    game: { ar: 'الألعاب والتحديات التفاعلية', en: 'Interactive Games' },\n    practice: { ar: 'التمارين التدريجية مع الرفيق', en: 'Guided Practice' },\n    reel_check: { ar: 'المقاطع التعليمية السريعة', en: 'Micro-Lessons & Reels' },\n    quiz: { ar: 'الاختبارات الذاتية القصيرة', en: 'Self-Check Quizzes' },\n    homework: { ar: 'تطبيق الواجبات المدرسية', en: 'Homework Tasks' },\n  };\n\n  const formatEffectiveness: ModalityEffectiveness[] = Object.entries(modalityStats)\n    .filter(([_, stats]) => stats.total > 0)\n    .map(([mod, stats]) => {\n      const retentionScore = Math.round((stats.fullCorrect / stats.total) * 100) / 100;\n      const meta = modalityLabels[mod] || { ar: mod, en: mod };\n      return {\n        modality: mod as ModalityEffectiveness['modality'],\n        labelAr: meta.ar,\n        labelEn: meta.en,\n        retentionScore,\n        sampleCount: stats.total,\n        descriptionAr: retentionScore >= 0.8\n          ? `أعلى معدل استيعاب وحفظ للمفاهيم (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}٪).`\n          : `معدل استيعاب متوسط (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}٪) يزداد مع الممارسة.`,\n        descriptionEn: retentionScore >= 0.8\n          ? `Highest retention and comprehension rate (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}%).`\n          : `Moderate retention (${Math.round(retentionScore * 100)}%) improves with frequency.`,\n      };\n    })\n    .sort((a, b) => b.retentionScore - a.retentionScore);\n\n  // When there is no recorded evidence, report no modalities rather than inventing stats.\n\n  // 6. Once you practise, a precise recommendation will appear.',\n  };\n\n  if (weakConcepts.length > 0) {\n    const focusTarget = weakConcepts[0];\n    recommendedFocus = {\n      subject: focusTarget.subject,\n      conceptNameAr: focusTarget.nameAr,\n      conceptNameEn: focusTarget.nameEn,\n      rationaleAr: `جلسة واحدة مدتها 10 دقائق لمفهوم (${focusTarget.nameAr}) كافية لاستعادة الثقة التامة.`,\n      rationaleEn: `A single 10-minute refresh for (${focusTarget.nameEn}) is enough to restore complete confidence.`,\n    };\n  } else if (repeatedErrors.length > 0) {\n    const errorTarget = repeatedErrors[0];\n    recommendedFocus = {\n      subject: errorTarget.subject,\n      conceptNameAr: errorTarget.nameAr,\n      conceptNameEn: errorTarget.nameEn,\n      rationaleAr: `مراجعة لطيفة للملاحظات الأساسية في (${errorTarget.nameAr}) لتلافي تكرار الأخطاء البسيطة.`,\n      rationaleEn: `A gentle review of key points in (${errorTarget.nameEn}) to prevent minor calculation slips.`,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 7.  "old_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport { Badge } from '../common/Badge';\nimport { SaveLikeButton } from '../collections/SaveLikeButton';\nimport {\n  CheckCircle2,\n  Bookmark,\n  Calendar,\n  Clock,\n  Sparkles,\n  RotateCcw,\n  Play,\n  FileText,\n  Trash2,\n  Edit3,\n  Plus,\n  TrendingUp,\n  AlertTriangle,\n  Lightbulb,\n  Award,\n  ChevronRight,\n  ShieldCheck,\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\nexport const ReviewScreen: React.FC = () => {\n  const {\n    student,\n    language,\n    masteryRecords,\n    allReviewSchedules,\n    savedItems,\n    collections,\n    weeklyReviews,\n    triggerManualReview,\n    generateAndOpenWeeklyReview,\n    createCollection,\n    updateSavedNote,\n    removeSavedItem,\n    t,\n  } = useApp();\n\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n\n  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<'spaced' | 'saved' | 'weekly'>('spaced');\n  const [selectedCollectionId, setSelectedCollectionId] = useState<string>('all');\n  const [editingNoteId, setEditingNoteId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [tempNote, setTempNote] = useState<string>('');\n  const [reviewFilter, setReviewFilter] = useState<'all' | 'due' | 'upcoming'>('due');\n\n  // Filtered Review Items\n  const dueItems = allReviewSchedules.items.filter((i) => i.isDue);\n  const upcomingItems = allReviewSchedules.items.filter((i) => !i.isDue);\n  const displayReviewItems =\n    reviewFilter === 'due'\n      ? dueItems\n      : reviewFilter === 'upcoming'\n      ? upcomingItems\n      : allReviewSchedules.items;\n\n  // Filtered Saved Items\n  const filteredSavedItems =\n    selectedCollectionId === 'all'\n      ? savedItems\n      : savedItems.filter((item) => item.collectionIds.includes(selectedCollectionId));\n\n  const handleStartEditNote = (itemId: string, currentNote?: string) => {\n    setEditingNoteId(itemId);\n    setTempNote(currentNote || '');\n  };\n\n  const handleSaveNote = async (itemId: string) => {\n    await updateSavedNote(itemId, tempNote);\n    setEditingNoteId(null);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 flex flex-col p-4 sm:p-5 max-w-lg mx-auto w-full pb-24 space-y-4\">\n      {/* Screen Header */}\n      <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n          <h1 className=\"text-lg font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <CheckCircle2 className=\"w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600\" />\n            <span>{isAr ? 'المراجعة والحفظ الذكي' : 'Review & Smart Saves'}</span>\n          </h1>\n          <Badge variant=\"demo\">Phase 7 Active</Badge>\n        </div>\n        <p className=\"text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400\">\n          {isAr\n            ? 'مراجعة متباعدة تكيفية، محفوظاتك الخاصة، وتقارير أسبوعية خالية من الضغوط.'\n            : 'Adaptive spaced revision, private collections, and guilt-free weekly reviews.'}\n        </p>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Sub-Tab Navigation Bar */}\n      <div className=\"flex p-1 bg-slate-200/70 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-2xl gap-1\">\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('spaced')}\n          className={`flex-1 py-2 px-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${\n            activeSubTab === 'spaced'\n              ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-xs'\n              : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900'\n          }`}\n        >\n          <RotateCcw className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n          <span>{isAr ? 'المراجعة المتباعدة' : 'Spaced Review'}</span>\n          {dueItems.length > 0 && (\n            <span className=\"w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-indigo-600 text-white text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center\">\n              {dueItems.length}\n            </span>\n          )}\n        </button>\n\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('saved')}\n          className={`flex-1 py-2 px-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${\n            activeSubTab === 'saved'\n              ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-xs'\n              : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900'\n          }`}\n        >\n          <Bookmark className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n          <span>{isAr ? 'المحفوظات' : 'Saved Items'}</span>\n          {savedItems.length > 0 && (\n            <span className=\"w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center\">\n              {savedItems.length}\n            </span>\n          )}\n        </button>\n\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('weekly')}\n          className={`flex-1 py-2 px-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${\n            activeSubTab === 'weekly'\n              ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-xs'\n              : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900'\n          }`}\n        >\n          <Calendar className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n          <span>{isAr ? 'التقرير الأسبوعي' : 'Weekly Review'}</span>\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}\n      {/* SUB-TAB 1: SPACED REVIEW */}\n      {/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}\n      {activeSubTab === 'spaced' && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-3\">\n          {/* Summary counters */}\n          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-3 gap-2\">\n            <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/40 text-center\">\n              <span className=\"text-[10px] text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 block font-bold\">\n                {isAr ? 'حان وقت مراجعتها' : 'Due for Review'}\n              </span>\n              <span className=\"text-lg font-black text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-100\">\n                {allReviewSchedules.dueCount}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-100 dark:border-amber-900/40 text-center\">\n              <span className=\"text-[10px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 block font-bold\">\n                {isAr ? 'تنبيه لطيف (+3 أيام)' : 'Gentle Nudge'}\n              </span>\n              <span className=\"text-lg font-black text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-100\">\n                {allReviewSchedules.overdueCount}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-center\">\n              <span className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block font-bold\">\n                {isAr ? 'مستقرة وقادمة' : 'Upcoming'}\n              </span>\n              <span className=\"text-lg font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\">\n                {allReviewSchedules.upcomingCount}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Filter Pills */}\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs\">\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setReviewFilter('due')}\n              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-bold transition-all ${\n                reviewFilter === 'due'\n                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'\n                  : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'\n              }`}\n            >\n              {isAr ? 'المستحقة الآن' : 'Due Now'} ({dueItems.length})\n            </button>\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setReviewFilter('upcoming')}\n              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-bold transition-all ${\n                reviewFilter === 'upcoming'\n                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'\n                  : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'\n              }`}\n            >\n              {isAr ? 'المراجعات القادمة' : 'Upcoming'} ({upcomingItems.length})\n            </button>\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setReviewFilter('all')}\n              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-bold transition-all ${\n                reviewFilter === 'all'\n                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'\n                  : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'\n              }`}\n            >\n              {isAr ? 'الكل' : 'All'} ({allReviewSchedules.items.length})\n            </button>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Review Concept Cards */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-2.5\">\n            {displayReviewItems.length === 0 ? (\n              <div className=\"p-8 text-center rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-2\">\n                <CheckCircle2 className=\"w-10 h-10 text-emerald-500 mx-auto\" />\n                <h4 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\">\n                  {isAr ? 'رائع! لا توجد مفاهيم مستحقة للمراجعة الآن' : 'All clear! No concepts due for review right now.'}\n                </h4>\n                <p className=\"text-[11px] text-slate-400 max-w-xs mx-auto\">\n                  {isAr\n                    ? 'الجدولة التكيفية ستنبهك بلطف عندما يحين موعد مراجعة أي مفهوم علمي للحفاظ على ثباته.'\n                    : 'The adaptive scheduler will gently remind you when any concept is ready for a refresh.'}\n                </p>\n              </div>\n            ) : (\n              displayReviewItems.map((item) => {\n                const intervalLabel =\n                  item.intervalDays >= 7\n                    ? isAr ? `متباعدة (${item.intervalDays} أيام)` : `Long-range (${item.intervalDays}d)`\n                    : item.intervalDays >= 3\n                    ? isAr ? `متوسطة (${item.intervalDays} أيام)` : `Medium (${item.intervalDays}d)`\n                    : isAr ? `قريبة (${item.intervalDays} يوم)` : `Quick (${item.intervalDays}d)`;\n\n                return (\n                  <div\n                    key={item.conceptId}\n                    className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xs space-y-2\"\n                  >\n                    <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                      <div className=\"space-y-0.5\">\n                        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap\">\n                          <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300\">\n                            {item.subjectName}\n                          </span>\n                          <span className=\"text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold\">\n                            {intervalLabel}\n                          </span>\n                          {item.isOverdue && (\n                            <span className=\"text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300\">\n                              {isAr ? `تنشيط لطيف (${item.overdueDays} أيام)` : `Gentle nudge (${item.overdueDays}d)`}\n                            </span>\n                          )}\n                        </div>\n                        <h4 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 pt-0.5\">\n                          {isAr ? item.conceptNameAr : item.conceptNameEn}\n                        </h4>\n                      </div>\n\n                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0\">\n                        {/* Save / Like */}\n                        <SaveLikeButton\n                          sourceId={item.conceptId}\n                          type=\"concept\"\n                          title={isAr ? item.conceptNameAr : item.conceptNameEn}\n                          subject={item.subjectName}\n                        />\n\n                        {/* Review this now trigger */}\n                        <button\n                          type=\"button\"\n                          onClick={() => triggerManualReview(item.conceptId)}\n                          className=\"py-1.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-white bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 active:scale-98 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1 transition-all\"\n                        >\n                          <Play className=\"w-3 h-3 fill-current\" />\n                          <span>{isAr ? 'راجع الآن' : 'Review Now'}</span>\n                        </button>\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n\n                    <p className=\"text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-snug\">\n                      {item.reason}\n                    </p>\n                  </div>\n                );\n              })\n            )}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}\n      {/* SUB-TAB 2: SAVED ITEMS & COLLECTIONS */}\n      {/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}\n      {activeSubTab === 'saved' && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-3\">\n          {/* Collection Pills Filter */}\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 text-xs no-scrollbar\">\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setSelectedCollectionId('all')}\n              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${\n                selectedCollectionId === 'all'\n                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'\n                  : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'\n              }`}\n            >\n              {isAr ? 'جميع المحفوظات' : 'All Saves'} ({savedItems.length})\n            </button>\n\n            {collections.map((col) => {\n              const isSelected = selectedCollectionId === col.id;\n              const count = savedItems.filter((i) => i.collectionIds.includes(col.id)).length;\n              return (\n                <button\n                  key={col.id}\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={() => setSelectedCollectionId(col.id)}\n                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${\n                    isSelected\n                      ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'\n                      : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'\n                  }`}\n                >\n                  <span>{isAr && col.nameAr ? col.nameAr : col.name}</span>\n                  <span className=\"opacity-70 text-[10px] ml-1 rtl:mr-1 rtl:ml-0 font-mono\">\n                    ({count})\n                  </span>\n                </button>\n              );\n            })}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Saved Items List */}\n          {filteredSavedItems.length === 0 ? (\n            <div className=\"p-8 text-center rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-2\">\n              <Bookmark className=\"w-10 h-10 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 mx-auto\" />\n              <h4 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\">\n                {isAr ? 'لا توجد عناصر محفوظة في هذه المجموعة بعد' : 'No items saved in this collection yet.'}\n              </h4>\n              <p className=\"text-[11px] text-slate-400 max-w-xs mx-auto\">\n                {isAr\n                  ? 'يمكنك حفظ أي درس، أو بطاقة مفهوم، أو ملاحظة، أو مقطع تعليمي بالضغط على أيقونة الإشارة المرجعية.'\n                  : 'You can save any lesson, quiz, concept card, or note by tapping the bookmark icon.'}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n          ) : (\n            <div className=\"space-y-2.5\">\n              {filteredSavedItems.map((item) => (\n                <div\n                  key={item.id}\n                  className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xs space-y-2.5\"\n                >\n                  <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                    <div className=\"space-y-0.5\">\n                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap\">\n                        <span className=\"text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase\">\n                          {item.type}\n                        </span>\n                        {item.subject && (\n                          <span className=\"text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/50 text-indigo-600\">\n                            {item.subject}\n                          </span>\n                        )}\n                      </div>\n                      <h4 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n                        {item.title}\n                      </h4>\n                    </div>\n\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0\">\n                      <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        onClick={() => handleStartEditNote(item.id, item.note)}\n                        title={isAr ? 'تعديل الملاحظة' : 'Edit note'}\n                        className=\"p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800\"\n                      >\n                        <Edit3 className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n                      </button>\n                      <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        onClick={() => removeSavedItem(item.id)}\n                        title={isAr ? 'حذف من المحفوظات' : 'Remove item'}\n                        className=\"p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800\"\n                      >\n                        <Trash2 className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n                      </button>\n                    </div>\n                  </div>\n\n                  {/* Note block */}\n                  {editingNoteId === item.id ? (\n                    <div className=\"space-y-1.5 pt-1\">\n                      <textarea\n                        rows={2}\n                        value={tempNote}\n                        onChange={(e) => setTempNote(e.target.value)}\n                        placeholder={isAr ? 'أضف ملاحظتك الشخصية...' : 'Add your note...'}\n                        className=\"w-full p-2 text-xs rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800\"\n                      />\n                      <div className=\"flex justify-end gap-1.5\">\n                        <button\n                          type=\"button\"\n                          onClick={() => setEditingNoteId(null)}\n                          className=\"py-1 px-2.5 text-[10px] text-slate-500\"\n                        >\n                          {t.common.cancel}\n                        </button>\n                        <button\n                          type=\"button\"\n                          onClick={() => handleSaveNote(item.id)}\n                          className=\"py-1 px-3 text-[10px] font-bold bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg\"\n                        >\n                          {isAr ? 'حفظ الملاحظة' : 'Save Note'}\n                        </button>\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n                  ) : item.note ? (\n                    <div className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-50/70 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200/60 dark:border-amber-900/40 text-[11px] text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 flex items-start gap-1.5\">\n                      <FileText className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5\" />\n                      <span>{item.note}</span>\n                    </div>\n                  ) : null}\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}\n      {/* SUB-TAB 3: WEEKLY REVIEWS */}\n      {/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}\n      {activeSubTab === 'weekly' && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-3\">\n          {/* Action to generate weekly review on demand */}\n          <div className=\"p-4 rounded-3xl bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-600 to-indigo-800 text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/20 flex items-center justify-between\">\n            <div className=\"space-y-0.5 max-w-[240px]\">\n              <span className=\"text-xs font-bold block\">\n                {isAr ? 'حصادك الأسبوعي المشجع' : 'Your Encouraging Weekly Win'}\n              </span>\n              <p className=\"text-[10px] text-indigo-100\">\n                {isAr\n                  ? 'يتولد تلقائياً كل 7 أيام أو عند طلبك عبر الرفيق أو بالضغط هنا.'\n                  : 'Auto-generated every 7 days, or on demand whenever you ask.'}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => generateAndOpenWeeklyReview(true)}\n              className=\"py-2 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-white text-indigo-700 font-bold text-xs shadow-xs hover:bg-indigo-50 active:scale-98 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5\"\n            >\n              <Sparkles className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500\" />\n              <span>{isAr ? 'أنشئ تقرير الأسبوع' : 'Generate Week'}</span>\n            </button>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Past Weekly Reviews List */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-3\">\n            {weeklyReviews.length === 0 ? (\n              <div className=\"p-8 text-center rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-2\">\n                <Calendar className=\"w-10 h-10 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 mx-auto\" />\n                <h4 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\">\n                  {isAr ? 'لا توجد تقارير أسبوعية مسجلة بعد' : 'No weekly reviews generated yet.'}\n                </h4>\n                <p className=\"text-[11px] text-slate-400 max-w-xs mx-auto\">\n                  {isAr\n                    ? 'اضغط على زر (أنشئ تقرير الأسبوع) بالأعلى للاطلاع على ملخص استيعابك وإنجازاتك في جو مريح.'\n                    : 'Tap \"Generate Week\" above to see your conceptual retention and wins.'}\n                </p>\n              </div>\n            ) : (\n              weeklyReviews.map((rev) => (\n                <div\n                  key={rev.id}\n                  className=\"p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm space-y-3.5\"\n                >\n                  {/* Card Header & Non-Guilt Tone Message */}\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2.5\">\n                    <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                      <div className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center\">\n                        <Calendar className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n                      </div>\n                      <div>\n                        <h4 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n                          {isAr ? 'تقرير الأسبوع الدراسي' : 'Weekly Review'} ({rev.weekStartDate} - {rev.weekEndDate})\n                        </h4>\n                        <span className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400\">\n                          {rev.timeSpentMinutes} {isAr ? 'دقيقة مذاكرة هادفة' : 'minutes studied'}\n                        </span>\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n                  </div>\n\n                  {/* Warm Tone Message Banner */}\n                  <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50/70 dark:bg-indigo-950/30 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/40 text-xs text-indigo-950 dark:text-indigo-200 leading-relaxed flex items-start gap-2\">\n                    <Sparkles className=\"w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5\" />\n                    <span>{isAr ? rev.toneMessageAr : rev.toneMessageEn}</span>\n                  </div>\n\n                  {/* Homework & Quiz Trends Counters */}\n                  <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs\">\n                    <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/60 space-y-1\">\n                      <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block\">\n                        {isAr ?  "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport { Badge } from '../common/Badge';\nimport { SaveLikeButton } from '../collections/SaveLikeButton';\nimport {\n  CheckCircle2,\n  Bookmark,\n  Calendar,\n  Clock,\n  Sparkles,\n  RotateCcw,\n  Play,\n  FileText,\n  Trash2,\n  Edit3,\n  Plus,\n  TrendingUp,\n  AlertTriangle,\n  Lightbulb,\n  Award,\n  ChevronRight,\n  ShieldCheck,\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\nexport const ReviewScreen: React.FC = () => {\n  const {\n    student,\n    language,\n    masteryRecords,\n    allReviewSchedules,\n    savedItems,\n    collections,\n    weeklyReviews,\n    triggerManualReview,\n    generateAndOpenWeeklyReview,\n    createCollection,\n    updateSavedNote,\n    removeSavedItem,\n    t,\n  } = useApp();\n\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n\n  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<'spaced' | 'saved' | 'weekly'>('spaced');\n  const [selectedCollectionId, setSelectedCollectionId] = useState<string>('all');\n  const [editingNoteId, setEditingNoteId] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [tempNote, setTempNote] = useState<string>('');\n  const [reviewFilter, setReviewFilter] = useState<'all' | 'due' | 'upcoming'>('due');\n\n  // Filtered Review Items\n  const dueItems = allReviewSchedules.items.filter((i) => i.isDue);\n  const upcomingItems = allReviewSchedules.items.filter((i) => !i.isDue);\n  const displayReviewItems =\n    reviewFilter === 'due'\n      ? dueItems\n      : reviewFilter === 'upcoming'\n      ? upcomingItems\n      : allReviewSchedules.items;\n\n  // Filtered Saved Items\n  const filteredSavedItems =\n    selectedCollectionId === 'all'\n      ? savedItems\n      : savedItems.filter((item) => item.collectionIds.includes(selectedCollectionId));\n\n  const handleStartEditNote = (itemId: string, currentNote?: string) => {\n    setEditingNoteId(itemId);\n    setTempNote(currentNote || '');\n  };\n\n  const handleSaveNote = async (itemId: string) => {\n    await updateSavedNote(itemId, tempNote);\n    setEditingNoteId(null);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 flex flex-col p-4 sm:p-5 max-w-lg mx-auto w-full pb-24 space-y-4\">\n      {/* Screen Header */}\n      <div className=\"space-y-1\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n          <h1 className=\"text-lg font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <CheckCircle2 className=\"w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600\" />\n            <span>{isAr ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-xs'\n              : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900'\n          }`}\n        >\n          <RotateCcw className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n          <span>{isAr ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-xs'\n              : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900'\n          }`}\n        >\n          <Bookmark className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n          <span>{isAr ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'\n                  : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'\n              }`}\n            >\n              {isAr ? 'المراجعات القادمة' : 'Upcoming'} ({upcomingItems.length})\n            </button>\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setReviewFilter('all')}\n              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-bold transition-all ${\n                reviewFilter === 'all'\n                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'\n                  : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400'\n              }`}\n            >\n              {isAr ? 'الكل' : 'All'} ({allReviewSchedules.items.length})\n            </button>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Review Concept Cards */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-2.5\">\n            {displayReviewItems.length === 0 ? (\n              <div className=\"p-8 text-center rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-2\">\n                <CheckCircle2 className=\"w-10 h-10 text-emerald-500 mx-auto\" />\n                <h4 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\">\n                  {isAr ? 'رائع! لا توجد مفاهيم مستحقة للمراجعة الآن' : 'All clear! No concepts due for review right now.'}\n                </h4>\n                <p className=\"text-[11px] text-slate-400 max-w-xs mx-auto\">\n                  {isAr\n                    ? isAr ? `متباعدة (${item.intervalDays} أيام)` : `Long-range (${item.intervalDays}d)`\n                    : item.intervalDays >= 3\n                    ? isAr ? `متوسطة (${item.intervalDays} أيام)` : `Medium (${item.intervalDays}d)`\n                    : isAr ? `قريبة (${item.intervalDays} يوم)` : `Quick (${item.intervalDays}d)`;\n\n                return (\n                  <div\n                    key={item.conceptId}\n                    className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xs space-y-2\"\n                  >\n                    <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-2\">\n                      <div className=\"space-y-0.5\">\n                        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap\">\n                          <span className=\"text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300\">\n                            {item.subjectName}\n                          </span>\n                          <span className=\"text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold\">\n                            {intervalLabel}\n                          </span>\n                          {item.isOverdue && (\n                            <span className=\"text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-950/60 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300\">\n                              {isAr ? `تنشيط لطيف (${item.overdueDays} أيام)` : `Gentle nudge (${item.overdueDays}d)`}\n                            </span>\n                          )}\n                        </div>\n                        <h4 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 pt-0.5\">\n                          {isAr ? 'راجع الآن' : 'Review Now'}</span>\n                        </button>\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n\n                    <p className=\"text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 leading-snug\">\n                      {item.reason}\n                    </p>\n                  </div>\n                );\n              })\n            )}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}\n      {/* SUB-TAB 2: SAVED ITEMS & COLLECTIONS */}\n      {/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}\n      {activeSubTab === 'saved' && (\n        <div className=\"space-y-3\">\n          {/* Collection Pills Filter */}\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 text-xs no-scrollbar\">\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setSelectedCollectionId('all')}\n              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all ${\n                selectedCollectionId === 'all'\n                  ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs'\n                      : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'\n                  }`}\n                >\n                  <span>{isAr && col.nameAr ? col.nameAr : col.name}</span>\n                  <span className=\"opacity-70 text-[10px] ml-1 rtl:mr-1 rtl:ml-0 font-mono\">\n                    ({count})\n                  </span>\n                </button>\n              );\n            })}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Saved Items List */}\n          {filteredSavedItems.length === 0 ? (\n            <div className=\"p-8 text-center rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-2\">\n              <Bookmark className=\"w-10 h-10 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 mx-auto\" />\n              <h4 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\">\n                {isAr ? 'لا توجد عناصر محفوظة في هذه المجموعة بعد' : 'No items saved in this collection yet.'}\n              </h4>\n              <p className=\"text-[11px] text-slate-400 max-w-xs mx-auto\">\n                {isAr\n                  ? Grounded fallback: reuse a second textbook exercise that ships its own options.\n  const grounded = lesson.exercises?.filter(\n    (candidate) =>\n      candidate.options?.length &&\n      candidate.expectedAnswer &&\n      candidate.options.includes(candidate.expectedAnswer)\n  );\n  const chosen = grounded?.find((exercise) => exercise.question !== lesson.exercises[0]?.question) || grounded?.[0];\n  if (chosen?.expectedAnswer && chosen.options) {\n    return {\n      id: `recheck_${cId}`,\n      conceptId: cId,\n      promptAr: chosen.question,\n      promptEn: chosen.question,\n      promptFr: chosen.question,\n      thinkingPromptAr: `اشرحي لي يا ${studentName} إزاي طبقتي القاعدة اللي شرحناها هنا؟`,\n      thinkingPromptEn: `Explain ${studentName} how you applied our rule here?`,\n      thinkingPromptFr: `Explique comment tu as appliqué la règle, ${studentName}.`,\n      correctIndex: 0,\n      options: chosen.options.map((option) => ({\n        textAr: option,\n        textEn: option,\n        textFr: option,\n        isCorrect: option === chosen.expectedAnswer,\n        explanationAr: option === chosen.expectedAnswer\n          ? options.\n  return {\n    id: 'recheck_none',\n    conceptId: cId,\n    promptAr: 'لا يوجد تمرين إضافي موثق في كتاب الوزارة لهذا الدرس بعد.',\n    promptEn: 'There is no additional sourced textbook exercise for this lesson yet.',\n    promptFr: 'Il n’y a pas encore d’exercice supplémentaire sourcé pour cette leçon.',\n    thinkingPromptAr: 'نحتاج تمريناً موثقاً من كتاب الوزارة قبل أن نتحقق من
