'مراجعة السبورة قبل إعادة الفحص' : 'Review the Chalkboard Before Retaking'}</span>\n                  </button>\n                )}\n\n                {/* Button 2: Inspect Knowledge Map */}\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  onClick={() => {\n                    soundEffects.playPop();\n                    setActiveTab('progress');\n                  }}\n                  className=\"w-full py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-750 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs\"\n                >\n                  <span>📊 {isArabic ? 'مراجعة خريطة الإتقان الشاملة' : 'View Full Knowledge Map'}</span>\n                </button>\n\n                <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 pt-1\">\n                  {/* Button 3: Pick another lesson */}\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => {\n                      soundEffects.playPop();\n                      setIsPickerOpen(true);\n                    }}\n                    className=\"flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-650 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer\"\n                  >\n                    <span>📚 {isArabic ? 'اختيار درس آخر' : 'Choose Another Lesson'}</span>\n                  </button>\n\n                  {/* Button 4: Retry Quiz */}\n                  <button\n                    type=\"button\"\n                    onClick={() => {\n                      soundEffects.playPop();\n                      setIsQuizCompleted(false);\n                      setCurrentQuizIndex(0);\n                      setSelectedAnswer(null);\n                      setQuizFeedback(null);\n                      setQuizRetried(false);\n                    }}\n                    className=\"py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 dark:hover:bg-slate-650 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer\"\n                  >\n                    <RotateCcw className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n                    <span>{isArabic ? 'إعادة الفحص' : 'Retry'}</span>\n                  </button>\n                </div>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          ) : (\n            /* STATE B: Active Question in Progress */\n            quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex] && (\n              <div className=\"space-y-3 pt-1\">\n                <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-slate-750 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700\">\n                  <span className=\"text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 block mb-1\">\n                    {isArabic ? 'السؤال:' : 'Question:'}\n                  </span>\n                  <h4 className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 leading-relaxed\">\n                    {isArabic\n                      ? quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex].questionAr\n                      : isFrench\n                      ? quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex].questionFr\n                      : quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex].questionEn}\n                  </h4>\n                </div>\n\n                {/* Options */}\n                <div className=\"space-y-1.5\">\n                  {(isArabic\n                    ? quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex].optionsAr\n                    : isFrench\n                    ? quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex].optionsFr\n                    : quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex].optionsEn\n                  ).map((opt, oIdx) => {\n                    const isSelected = selectedAnswer === oIdx;\n                    const isCorrect = oIdx === quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex].correctIndex;\n                    const showResult = selectedAnswer !== null;\n                    // Never reveal which option is correct before the retry is used:\n                    // otherwise \"try again with hint\" is pointless and mastery is faked.\n                    const revealCorrect = isCorrect && (isCorrect === isSelected || quizRetried);\n\n                    return (\n                      <button\n                        key={oIdx}\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        disabled={selectedAnswer !== null}\n                        onClick={() => handleSelectQuizOption(oIdx)}\n                        className={`w-full p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold text-right rtl:text-right ltr:text-left transition-all flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer ${\n                          showResult\n                            ? revealCorrect\n                              ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-500 text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-200'\n                              : isSelected\n                              ? 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/60 border-rose-500 text-rose-900 dark:text-rose-200'\n                              : 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 opacity-60'\n                            : 'bg-slate-50 hover:bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'\n                        }`}\n                      >\n                        <span>{opt}</span>\n                        {showResult && (\n                          <span>\n                            {revealCorrect ? (\n                              <CheckCircle2 className=\"w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600\" />\n                            ) : isSelected ? (\n                              <XCircle className=\"w-4 h-4 text-rose-600\" />\n                            ) : null}\n                          </span>\n                        )}\n                      </button>\n                    );\n                  })}\n                </div>\n\n                {/* ADAPT IF WRONG: Pedagogical Feedback & Adaptive Intervention Box */}\n                {selectedAnswer !== null && (\n                  <div className=\"pt-2 animate-in fade-in duration-200 space-y-2.5\">\n                    {/* Feedback message */}\n                    <div className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900 text-xs font-medium text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 leading-relaxed\">\n                      {quizFeedback}\n                    </div>\n\n                    {/* If Wrong: Adaptive Pedagogical Guidance */}\n                    {selectedAnswer !== quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex].correctIndex && (\n                      <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-800 space-y-2\">\n                        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200\">\n                          <Lightbulb className=\"w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400\" />\n                          <span>{isArabic ? 'تلميح مس نور المساعد 💡' : 'Miss Nour\\'s Adaptive Hint 💡'}</span>\n                        </div>\n                        <p className=\"text-xs text-amber-800/90 dark:text-amber-300/90 leading-relaxed\">\n                          {isArabic\n                            ? quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex].explanationAr\n                            : isFrench\n                            ? quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex].explanationFr\n                            : quizQuestions[currentQuizIndex].explanationEn}\n                        </p>\n                        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 pt-1\">\n                          <button\n                            type=\"button\"\n                            onClick={() => {\n                              soundEffects.playPop();\n                              setSelectedAnswer(null);\n                              setQuizFeedback(null);\n                              setQuizRetried(true);\n                              const retryMsg = isArabic\n                                ? `يلا يا ${studentName}! جربي السؤال تاني بهدوء، أنا واثقة فيكي!`\n                                : `Try again ${studentName}! Take your time!`;\n                              speakText(retryMsg, 'talking');\n                            }}\n                            className=\"flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white font-black text-xs shadow-xs transition-all active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 cursor-pointer\"\n                          >\n                            <RotateCcw className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n                            <span>{isArabic ? 'إعادة المحاولة مع التلميح 🔄' : 'Try Again with Hint 🔄'}</span>\n                          </button>\n\n                          <button\n                            type=\"button\"\n                            onClick={() => {\n                              soundEffects.playPop();\n                              setActiveStation('chalkboard');\n                              setExplanationSubTab('chalkboard');\n                              const boardMsg = isArabic\n                                ? `تعالي نراجع السبورة ونقرأ النقطة دي تاني سوا يا ${studentName}!`\n                                : `Let's review this on the chalkboard together!`;\n                              speakText(boardMsg, 'talking');\n                            }}\n                            className=\"py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer\"\n                          >\n                            <span>📝 {isArabic ? 'شرح السبورة' : 'Blackboard'}</span>\n                          </button>\n                        </div>\n                      </div>\n                    )}\n\n                    {/* Button to proceed: Next Question or Complete Check */}\n                    <button\n                      type=\"button\"\n                      onClick={handleNextQuizQuestion}\n                      className=\"w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-linear-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-500 hover:from-amber-300 hover:to-amber-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-xs shadow-md transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer\"\n                    >\n                      <span>\n                        {currentQuizIndex < quizQuestions.length - 1\n                          ? (isArabic ? 'السؤال التالي ←' : 'Next Question →')\n                          : (isArabic ? 'إنهاء الفحص وعرض الإتقان ⭐' : 'Finish & View Mastery ⭐')}\n                      </span>\n                    </button>\n                  </div>\n                )}\n              </div>\n            )\n          )}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* STATION 3: VOCABULARY & FLASHCARDS */}\n      {activeStation === 'vocab' && (\n        <div className=\"p-3.5 sm:p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-3\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n              <span className=\"text-xl\">📘</span>\n              <div>\n                <h3 className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n                  {isArabic ? 'المفردات والمصطلحات الرسمية' : 'Textbook Vocabulary'}\n                </h3>\n                <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400\">\n                  {isArabic ? 'اضغطي على أي بطاقة لتسمعي النطق والمعنى من مس نور' : 'Tap any card to hear pronunciation'}\n                </p>\n              </div>\n            </div>\n            <span className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 font-mono\">\n              {vocabCards.length} {isArabic ? 'كلمات' : 'words'}\n            </span>\n          </div>\n\n          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2\">\n            {vocabCards.map((card, idx) => {\n              const isSelected = activeVocabIndex === idx;\n              return (\n                <div\n                  key={idx}\n                  onClick={() => handleSelectVocabCard(idx)}\n                  className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border transition-all cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between gap-1.5 ${\n                    isSelected\n                      ? 'bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 border-indigo-500 shadow-sm'\n                      : 'bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-750 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700'\n                  }`}\n                >\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n                    <span className=\"text-base\">{card.icon}</span>\n                    <button\n                      type=\"button\"\n                      onClick={(e) => {\n                        e.stopPropagation();\n                        handleSelectVocabCard(idx);\n                      }}\n                      className=\"p-1 rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300 shadow-xs\"\n                    >\n                      <Volume2 className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5\" />\n                    </button>\n                  </div>\n                  <div>\n                    <h4 className=\"text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n                      {card.word}\n                    </h4>\n                    <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed\">\n                      {isArabic ? card.meaningAr : isFrench ? card.meaningFr : card.meaningEn}\n                    </p>\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n              );\n            })}\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* STATION 4: ASK MISS NOUR (LIVE INTERACTIVE DISCUSSION & VOICE INPUT) */}\n      {activeStation === 'ask' && (\n        <div className=\"p-3.5 sm:p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 shadow-sm border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 space-y-3\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <span className=\"text-xl\">💬</span>\n            <div>\n              <h3 className=\"text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n                {isArabic ? 'اسألي المعلمة نور عن أي شيء في الدرس' : 'Ask Miss Nour Anything'}\n              </h3>\n              <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400\">\n                {isArabic ? 'اكتبي أو تحدثي بصوتك ومس نور ستجيبك بالشرح الصوتي!' : 'Type or speak your question aloud'}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Quick Prompt Chips */}\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 text-[10px] font-bold\">\n            {[\n              isArabic ? 'مش فاهمة الفقرة الأولى' : \"I don't understand the first paragraph\",\n              isArabic ? 'اشرحي لي بطريقة تانية' : 'Explain differently',\n              isArabic ? 'إيه أهم سؤال في الامتحان؟' : 'What is the key exam question?',\n              isArabic ? 'معنى الكلمات الصعبة' : 'Hard vocabulary meaning',\n            ].map((prompt, i) => (\n              <button\n                key={i}\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => {\n                  setAskInput(prompt);\n                }}\n                className=\"px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 shrink-0 transition-all cursor-pointer\"\n              >\n                {prompt}\n              </button>\n            ))}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Voice Input & Text Control */}\n          <div className=\"space-y-2\">\n            <VoiceInputControl\n              onTranscriptConfirmed={(text) => {\n                setAskInput(text);\n              }}\n            />\n\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n              <input\n                type=\"text\"\n                value={askInput}\n                onChange={(e) => setAskInput(e.target.value)}\n                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleAskQuestion()}\n                placeholder={\n                  isArabic\n                    ? 'اكتبي سؤالك لمس نور هنا...'\n                    : 'Type your question to Miss Nour here...'\n                }\n                className=\"flex-1 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-750 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:border-indigo-500\"\n              />\n\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                disabled={!askInput.trim() || isAnswering}\n                onClick={handleAskQuestion}\n                className=\"p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center shrink-0\"\n              >\n                <Send className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n              </button>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* CURRICULUM SUBJECT & LESSON PICKER MODAL */}\n      <CurriculumSubjectPickerModal\n        isOpen={isPickerOpen}\n        onClose={() => setIsPickerOpen(false)}\n        onSelectLesson={handleSelectLesson}\n        initialSubjectId={currentLesson.subjectId}\n      />\n\n      {/* STAGE MODAL (THE STAGE LIVE INTERACTIVE EXPERIENCE) */}\n      {isFullStageOpen && (\n        <StageModal\n          lessonId={currentLesson.id}\n          onClose={() => setIsFullStageOpen(false)}\n        />\n      )}\n\n      {/* LESSON STUDY TEXTBOOK MODAL */}\n      {isStudyModalOpen && (\n        <LessonStudyModal\n          lesson={currentLesson}\n          onClose={() => setIsStudyModalOpen(false)}\n        />\n      )}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",

}

name.toLowerCase().trim();\n\n  // French Math\n  if (\n    (clean.includes('math') && (clean.includes('fr') || clean.includes('فرنس'))) ||\n    clean.includes('mathématiques') ||\n    clean.includes('رياضيات بالفرنسية')\n  ) {\n    return 'math_fr';\n  }\n\n  // French Science\n  if (\n    (clean.includes('sci') && (clean.includes('fr') || clean.includes('فرنس'))) ||\n    clean.includes('sciences fr') ||\n    clean.includes('علوم بالفرنسية')\n  ) {\n    return 'science_fr';\n  }\n\n  // French Language\n  if (clean.includes('فرنساوي') || clean.includes('فرنسي') || clean.includes('french') || clean.includes('français')) {\n    return 'french';\n  }\n\n  if (clean.includes('عرب') || clean.includes('arabic')) return 'arabic';\n  if (clean.includes('رياض') || clean.includes('حساب') || clean.includes('math')) return 'math';\n  if (clean.includes('علوم') || clean.includes('ساينس') || clean.includes('science')) return 'science';\n  if (clean.includes('دراس') || clean.includes('social')) return 'social';\n  if (clean.includes('إنجليز') || clean.includes('انجليز') || clean.includes('english')) return 'english';\n  if (clean.includes('تكنولوج') || clean.includes('ict')) return 'ict';\n  if (clean.includes('دين') || clean.includes('islamic') || clean.includes('religion')) return 'religion';\n  if (clean.includes('رسم') || clean.includes('فني') || clean.includes('art')) return 'art';\n  if (clean.includes('رياضي') || clean.includes('pe') || clean.includes('gym') || clean.includes('ألعاب')) return 'pe';\n  if (clean.includes('خط') || clean.includes('calligraphy')) return 'calligraphy';\n  return clean;\n}\n\nexport function detectSilenceOrAmnesia(text: string): boolean {\n  const trimmed = text.trim().toLowerCase();\n  if (!trimmed) return true;\n  const silencePhrases = [\n    'مش فاكر',\n    'نسيت',\n    'مش متذكر',\n    'مش عارف',\n    'don\\'t remember',\n    'dont remember',\n    'i forgot',\n    'forgot',\n    'nothing',\n    'لا اتذكر',\n    'معرفش',\n  ];\n  return silencePhrases.some((p) => trimmed.includes(p));\n}\n\nexport function detectVagueness(text: string): boolean {\n  const trimmed = text.trim().toLowerCase();\n  const vaguePhrases = [\n    'عادي',\n    'معملناش حاجة',\n    'درسنا وخلاص',\n    'يوم عادي',\n    'حاجات عادية',\n    'stuff',\n    'we did stuff',\n    'nothing special',\n    'just normal',\n  ];\n  const words = trimmed.split(/\\s+/);\n  return vaguePhrases.some((p) => trimmed === p || trimmed.includes(p)) || (words.length <= 2 && !trimmed.includes('واجب') && !trimmed.includes('درس'));\n}\n\n/**\n * Pure logic reconciliation between AI extracted day data and the student's timetable.\n */\nexport function reconcileDayWithTimetable(\n  extracted: ExtractedDayData,\n  timetable: Timetable | null,\n  dayKey: SchoolDayKey | null,\n  language: Language\n): ReconciliationResult {\n  const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n\n  // 1. Extract scheduled subjects from timetable\n  let scheduledSubjects: string[] = [];\n  if (timetable && timetable.days && dayKey) {\n    const todaySchedule = timetable.days.find((d) => d.day === dayKey);\n    if (todaySchedule) {\n      scheduledSubjects = todaySchedule.periods\n        .filter((p) => !p.isBreak && !p.subject.includes('استراحة') && !p.subject.includes('فسحة'))\n        .map((p) => p.subject);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Deduplicate scheduled subjects\n  const uniqueScheduled = Array.from(new Set(scheduledSubjects));\n  const normalizedScheduled = new Map<string, string>(); // normalizedKey -> originalName\n  for (const s of uniqueScheduled) {\n    normalizedScheduled.set(normalizeSubject(s), s);\n  }\n\n  // 2. Extract mentioned subjects from student's extracted data\n  const mentionedSet = new Set<string>();\n  extracted.lessonsCovered.forEach((l) => mentionedSet.add(l.subject));\n  extracted.homeworkAssigned.forEach((h) => mentionedSet.add(h.subject));\n  const mentionedSubjects = Array.from(mentionedSet);\n\n  const normalizedMentioned = new Set<string>();\n  for (const s of mentionedSubjects) {\n    normalizedMentioned.add(normalizeSubject(s));\n  }\n\n  // 3. Compare sets\n  const unexpectedSubjects: string[] = [];\n  const missingTimetableSubjects: string[] = [];\n\n  // If timetable is missing entirely, skip mismatch flags (rely fully on student description)\n  if (uniqueScheduled.length > 0) {\n    for (const [norm, orig] of normalizedScheduled.entries()) {\n      if (!normalizedMentioned.has(norm)) {\n        missingTimetableSubjects.push(orig);\n      }\n    }\n\n    for (const m of mentionedSubjects) {\n      if (!normalizedScheduled.has(normalizeSubject(m))) {\n        unexpectedSubjects.push(m);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  const discrepancies: DayRecordDiscrepancies = {\n    missingTimetableSubjects: missingTimetableSubjects.length > 0 ? missingTimetableSubjects : undefined,\n    unexpectedSubjects: unexpectedSubjects.length > 0 ? unexpectedSubjects : undefined,\n    isVague: extracted.isVague || extracted.detectedConfidence === 'vague',\n    notes: extracted.notes,\n  };\n\n  // 4. Generate Neutral Follow-up Prompt based on failure paths\n  let neutralFollowUpPrompt: string | undefined;\n\n  if (extracted.isSilence) {\n    // Failure path 1: Student says nothing / doesn't remember\n    if (uniqueScheduled.length > 0) {\n      const topSubjects = uniqueScheduled.slice(0, 2).join(isArabic ? ' و ' : ' and ');\n      neutralFollowUpPrompt = isArabic\n        ? `ولا يهمك خالص! حسب جدولك كان عندك النهارده ${topSubjects}. تحب تقولي إيه اللي حصل في ${uniqueScheduled[0]}؟`\n        : `No worries at all! According to your timetable you had ${topSubjects} today. Want to tell me what happened in ${uniqueScheduled[0]}?`;\n    } else {\n      neutralFollowUpPrompt = isArabic\n        ? 'ولا يهمك يا بطل! فاكر أي مادة أو واجب أخدته النهارده نبدأ بيه؟'\n        : 'No problem at all! Do you remember any specific subject or homework you received today?';\n    }\n  } else if (unexpectedSubjects.length > 0 && uniqueScheduled.length > 0) {\n    // Failure path 2: Description contradicts timetable\n    const firstUnexpected = unexpectedSubjects[0];\n    const missingExample = missingTimetableSubjects[0] || uniqueScheduled[0];\n    neutralFollowUpPrompt = isArabic\n      ? `جدولك بيقول كان عندك ${missingExample} النهارده، وأنت ذكرت ${firstUnexpected} — هل الجدول اتغير النهارده في المدرسة؟`\n      : `Your timetable shows ${missingExample} today, and you mentioned ${firstUnexpected} — did your school schedule change today?`;\n  } else if (discrepancies.isVague) {\n    // Failure path 3: Student was vague (\"we did stuff\")\n    const focusSub = uniqueScheduled[0] || (isArabic ? 'أي مادة' : 'any subject');\n    neutralFollowUpPrompt = isArabic\n      ? `فهمت إن اليوم كان ماشي بهدوء. يا ترى أخدتم درس جديد أو حل تمارين في ${focusSub}؟`\n      : `Got it! Did you start a new lesson or practice problems in ${focusSub} today?`;\n  }\n\n  // 5. Generate Natural Language Readback Summary\n  const naturalLanguageSummary = generateNaturalLanguageSummary(\n    extracted.lessonsCovered,\n    extracted.homeworkAssigned,\n    language\n  );\n\n  return {\n    discrepancies,\n    scheduledSubjects: uniqueScheduled,\n    mentionedSubjects,\n    neutralFollowUpPrompt,\n    naturalLanguageSummary,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Reads back the proposed Day Record in warm natural language (NEVER a sterile form).\n * E.g.: \"So today you had Arabic — new lesson on verbs, homework due tomorrow. And Math — fractions practice. Did I get that right?\"\n */\nexport function generateNaturalLanguageSummary(\n  lessons: LessonCovered[],\n  homework: HomeworkItem[],\n  language: Language\n): string {\n  const isArabic = language === 'ar';\n\n  if (lessons.length === 0 && homework.length === 0) {\n    return isArabic\n      ? 'سجلت إن اليوم كان مراجعة عامة بدون واجبات جديدة مسجلة. تحب نضيف أي تفاصيل تانية؟'\n      : 'I noted that today was a general review day with no new homework recorded. Would you like to add anything else?';\n  }\n\n  const parts: string[] = [];\n\n  lessons.forEach((l) => {\n    if (isArabic) {\n      let desc = `في ${l.subject}`;\n      if (l.topic) desc += `: درس «${l.topic}»`;\n      if (l.notes) desc += ` (${l.notes})`;\n      parts.push(desc);\n    } else {\n      let desc = `in ${l.subject}`;\n      if (l.topic) desc += `: lesson on \"${l.topic}\"`;\n      if (l.notes) desc += ` (${l.notes})`;\n      parts.push(desc);\n    }\n  });\n\n  const hwParts: string[] = [];\n  homework.forEach((h) => {\n    if (isArabic) {\n      let desc = `واجب ${h.subject}`;\n      if (h.description) desc += `: ${h.description}`;\n      if (h.dueDate) desc += ` (تسليم: ${h.dueDate})`;\n      hwParts.push(desc);\n    } else {\n      let desc = `homework for ${h.subject}`;\n      if (h.description) desc += `: ${h.description}`;\n      if (h.dueDate) desc += ` (due: ${h.dueDate})`;\n      hwParts.push(desc);\n    }\n  });\n\n  if (isArabic) {\n    let summary = 'يعني النهارده ';\n    if (parts.length > 0) {\n      summary += parts.join('، ومادة ') + '.';\n    }\n    if (hwParts.length > 0) {\n      summary += ' وبالنسبة للواجبات: ' + hwParts.join('، و') + '.';\n    }\n    summary += ' فهمت كلامك صح كده ولا تحب نعدل حاجة؟';\n    return summary;\n  } else {\n    let summary = 'So today you had ';\n    if (parts.length > 0) {\n      summary += parts.join(', and ') + '.';\n    }\n    if (hwParts.length > 0) {\n      summary += ' And for homework: ' + hwParts.join(', and ') + '.';\n    }\n    summary += ' Did I get that right, or would you like to tweak anything?';\n    return summary;\n  }\n}\n",
 "kind": "FileEditorObservation"
}

DEFAULT_PARENT_PREFERENCES: ParentPreferences = {\n  defaultAvailableMinutesPerDay: 45,\n  bedtime: '21:30',\n  bedtimeEnforced: true,\n  voiceEnabledGlobally: true,\n};\n\n/**\n * Creates or updates a linked parent account with PIN protection.\n */\nexport async function linkParentAccount(\n  storage: IStorageService,\n  studentId: string,\n  data: {\n    parentEmail: string;\n    parentName: string;\n    pin: string;\n    preferences?: Partial<ParentPreferences>;\n  }\n): Promise<ParentAccount> {\n  const account: ParentAccount = {\n    id: `parent_${studentId}`,\n    studentId,\n    parentEmail: data.parentEmail.trim().toLowerCase(),\n    parentName: data.parentName.trim(),\n    pin: data.pin.trim(),\n    isLinked: true,\n    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n    preferences: {\n      ...DEFAULT_PARENT_PREFERENCES,\n      ...(data.preferences || {}),\n    },\n  };\n\n  await storage.saveParentAccount(account);\n  return account;\n}\n\n/**\n * Verifies if entered PIN matches the stored parent PIN.\n */\nexport function verifyPin(account: ParentAccount, enteredPin: string): boolean {\n  if (!account || !account.pin) return false;\n  return account.pin.trim() === enteredPin.trim();\n}\n\n/**\n * Checks if current time is past the parent-enforced bedtime.\n */\nexport function isPastBedtime(preferences: ParentPreferences, currentTimeStr?: string): boolean {\n  if (!preferences.bedtimeEnforced || !preferences.bedtime) return false;\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const currentFormatted = currentTimeStr || `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;\n\n  return currentFormatted >= preferences.bedtime;\n}\n\nexport interface BuildParentSummaryParams {\n  student: Student;\n  dayRecords: completedMissions,\n    homeworkItems,\n    language = 'ar',\n  } = params;\n\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n  const flatConcepts = curriculumService.getFlatConcepts();\n  const conceptMap = new 'تسجيل حضور والتزام إيجابي في بدء المذاكرة المدرسية اليومية.'\n        : 'Consistent engagement and positive start to daily learning.'\n    );\n  }\n\n  // 6. One recommended action\n  const recommendedAction = isAr\n    ? 'تشجيع الطالب بكلمة ثناء على التزامه اليومي، ومنحه استراحة مريحة بعد جلسات المذاكرة المسائية.'\n    : 'Offer verbal encouragement for consistent study habits and ensure a relaxing break after evening sessions.';\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const weekStart = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toLocaleDateString(isAr ? 'ar-EG' : 'en-US', {\n    month: 'short',\n    day: 'numeric',\n  });\n  const weekEnd = now.toLocaleDateString(isAr ? 'ar-EG' : 'en-US', {\n    month: 'short',\n    day: 'numeric',\n  });\n\n  return {\n    studentName: student.name,\n    grade: student.grade,\n    weekRange: `${weekStart} - ${weekEnd}`,\n    lessonsCoveredCount: lessonsCount,\n    homeworkCompletedCount: hwCompleted,\n    homeworkTotalCount: hwTotal,\n    upcomingReviewsCount,\n    subjectsNeedingAttention,\n    recentAchievements,\n    recommendedAction,\n  };\n}\n",

'خريطة المعرفة والمنهج التفصيلية (54 مفهوماً)' : 'Full Knowledge Map Tree (54 Concepts)'}</span>\n          </div>\n          {showKnowledgeMapFull ? <ChevronUp className=\"w-4 h-4 text-slate-400\" /> : <ChevronDown className=\"w-4 h-4 text-slate-400\" />}\n        </button>\n\n        {showKnowledgeMapFull && (\n          <div className=\"rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 overflow-hidden bg-white dark:bg-slate-900\">\n            <KnowledgeMap />\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport { KnowledgeMap } from '../mastery/KnowledgeMap';\nimport { Badge } from '../common/Badge';\nimport { formatMasteryView } from '../../services/mastery/masteryEngine';\nimport { curriculumService } from '../../services/curriculum/curriculumService';\nimport {\n  TrendingUp,\n  Download,\n  Calendar,\n  Sparkles,\n  Award,\n  ShieldCheck,\n  Compass,\n  CheckCircle2,\n  Clock,\n  Layers,\n  Heart,\n  ChevronDown,\n  ChevronUp,\n} from 'lucide-react';\nimport { localDateStr } from '../../utils/time';\n\nexport const ProgressScreen: React.FC = () => {\n  const {\n    student,\n    language,\n    masteryRecords,\n    gamification,\n    missionsForToday,\n    currentDayRecord,\n    exportProgressData,\n    t,\n  } = useApp();\n\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n  const flatConcepts = useMemo(() => curriculumService.getFlatConcepts(), []);\n  const conceptMap = useMemo(() => new Map(flatConcepts.map((c) => [c.id, c])), [flatConcepts]);\n\n  const [showKnowledgeMapFull, setShowKnowledgeMapFull] = useState<boolean>(true);\n\n  // 1. Summary counters (mastered / learning / needs_review / unstarted)\n  const stats = useMemo(() => {\n    let mastered = 0;\n    let learning = 0;\n    let needsReview = 0;\n    let unstarted = 0;\n\n    for (const c of flatConcepts) {\n      const rec = masteryRecords[c.id];\n      const view = formatMasteryView(rec, language);\n      if (!view.hasEvidence) unstarted++;\n      else if (view.threshold === 'mastered') mastered++;\n      else if (view.threshold === 'needs_review') needsReview++;\n      else if (view.threshold === 'learning') learning++;\n    }\n\n    return { mastered, learning, needsReview, unstarted };\n  }, [flatConcepts, masteryRecords, language]);\n\n  // 2. Strengths: Top 5 concepts by score × confidence\n  const strengths = useMemo(() => {\n    const list: Array<{\n      conceptId: string;\n      nameAr: string;\n      nameEn: string;\n      subject: string;\n      metric: number;\n      score: number;\n      confidenceBand: string;\n    }> = [];\n\n    for (const c of flatConcepts) {\n      const rec = masteryRecords[c.id];\n      if (rec && rec.evidenceCount > 0) {\n        const view = formatMasteryView(rec, language);\n        const metric = rec.score * rec.confidence;\n        const subjName = c.subjectId === 'subj_math'\n          ? (isAr ? 'الرياضيات' : 'Mathematics')\n          : c.subjectId === 'subj_arabic'\n          ? (isAr ? 'اللغة العربية' : 'Arabic')\n          : (isAr ? 'العلوم' : 'Science');\n\n        list.push({\n          conceptId: c.id,\n          nameAr: c.nameAr,\n          nameEn: c.nameEn,\n          subject: subjName,\n          metric,\n          score: Math.round(rec.score * 100),\n          confidenceBand: view.compositeLabel,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return list.sort((a, b) => b.metric - a.metric).slice(0, 5);\n  }, [flatConcepts, masteryRecords, language, isAr]);\n\n  // 3. Growth areas: Bottom 5 concepts with evidence (where support is most beneficial)\n  const growthAreas = useMemo(() => {\n    const list: Array<{\n      conceptId: string;\n      nameAr: string;\n      nameEn: string;\n      subject: string;\n      score: number;\n      confidenceBand: string;\n    }> = [];\n\n    for (const c of flatConcepts) {\n      const rec = masteryRecords[c.id];\n      if (rec && rec.evidenceCount > 0) {\n        const view = formatMasteryView(rec, language);\n        const subjName = c.subjectId === 'subj_math'\n          ? (isAr ? 'الرياضيات' : 'Mathematics')\n          : c.subjectId === 'subj_arabic'\n          ? (isAr ? 'اللغة العربية' : 'Arabic')\n          : (isAr ? 'العلوم' : 'Science');\n\n        list.push({\n          conceptId: c.id,\n          nameAr: c.nameAr,\n          nameEn: c.nameEn,\n          subject: subjName,\n          score: Math.round(rec.score * 100),\n          confidenceBand: view.compositeLabel,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return list.sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score).slice(0, 5);\n  }, [flatConcepts, masteryRecords, language, isAr]);\n\n  // 4. Streak-free progress data: concepts touched per day (last 14 days), from real evidence only\n  const dailyActivity = useMemo(() => {\n    const days: Array<{\n      dateStr: string;\n      displayLabel: string;\n      conceptsTouched: number;\n    }> = [];\n\n    // Build a real per-day count from persisted evidence timestamps.\n    const evidenceCountByDate = new Map<string, number>();\n    for (const rec of Object.values(masteryRecords)) {\n      for (const entry of rec.evidenceLog || []) {\n        const dateKey = localDateStr(new Date(entry.timestamp));\n        evidenceCountByDate.set(dateKey, (evidenceCountByDate.get(dateKey) || 0) + 1);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const now = new Date();\n    for (let i = 13; i >= 0; i--) {\n      const d = new Date(now.getTime() - i * 24 * 3600 * 1000);\n      const dateStr = localDateStr(d);\n      const displayLabel = d.toLocaleDateString(isAr ? 'ar-EG' : 'en-US', {\n        weekday: 'narrow',\n        day: 'numeric',\n      });\n\n      days.push({\n        dateStr,\n        displayLabel,\n        conceptsTouched: evidenceCountByDate.get(dateStr) || 0,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return days;\n  }, [isAr, masteryRecords]);\n\n  const maxConcepts = Math.max(1, ...dailyActivity.map((d) => d.conceptsTouched));\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"flex-1 flex flex-col p-4 sm:p-5 max-w-lg mx-auto w-full pb-24 space-y-4\">\n      {/* Header */}\n      <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n        <div>\n          <h1 className=\"text-lg font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <TrendingUp className=\"w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600\" />\n            <span>{isAr ? 'لوحة التقدم والإنجاز الفردي' : 'Personal Progress & Mastery'}</span>\n          </h1>\n          <p className=\"text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400\">\n            {isAr\n              ? 'متابعة مسارك الخاص دون مقارنات أو تصنيفات تنافسية.'\n              : 'Track your personal learning trajectory without competitive peer rankings.'}\n          </p>\n        </div>\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          onClick={exportProgressData}\n          title={isAr ? 'تصدير البيانات بصيغة JSON' : 'Export Data (JSON)'}\n          className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors\"\n        >\n          <Download className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n          <span className=\"hidden sm:inline\">{isAr ? 'تصدير' : 'Export'}</span>\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* SECTION B: SUMMARY COUNTERS */}\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-4 gap-2\">\n        <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-900/40 text-center\">\n          <span className=\"text-[10px] text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 block font-bold\">\n            {isAr ? 'متقن' : 'Mastered'}\n          </span>\n          <span className=\"text-lg font-black text-emerald-900 dark:text-emerald-100\">\n            {stats.mastered}\n          </span>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-100 dark:border-indigo-900/40 text-center\">\n          <span className=\"text-[10px] text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 block font-bold\">\n            {isAr ? 'قيد التعلم' : 'Learning'}\n          </span>\n          <span className=\"text-lg font-black text-indigo-900 dark:text-indigo-100\">\n            {stats.learning}\n          </span>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-100 dark:border-amber-900/40 text-center\">\n          <span className=\"text-[10px] text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 block font-bold\">\n            {isAr ? 'يحتاج دعم' : 'Needs Review'}\n          </span>\n          <span className=\"text-lg font-black text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-100\">\n            {stats.needsReview}\n          </span>\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"p-3 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-center\">\n          <span className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block font-bold\">\n            {isAr ? 'لم يبدأ' : 'Unstarted'}\n          </span>\n          <span className=\"text-lg font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\">\n            {stats.unstarted}\n          </span>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* SECTION F: STREAK-FREE PROGRESS CHART (NO STREAK PRESSURE) */}\n      <div className=\"p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm space-y-3\">\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <Clock className=\"w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600\" />\n            <h3 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n              {isAr ? 'دقائق المذاكرة اليومية (آخر 14 يوماً)' : 'Daily Study Minutes (Last 14 Days)'}\n            </h3>\n          </div>\n          <span className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-medium\">\n            {isAr ? 'بدون ضغط السلاسل' : 'Zero pressure'}\n          </span>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Visual Bar Chart */}\n        <div className=\"h-28 flex items-end justify-between gap-1 pt-4 pb-1 px-1 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800\">\n          {dailyActivity.map((day, idx) => {\n            const heightPercent = Math.max(8, Math.round((day.minutes / maxMinutes) * 100));\n            const hasActivity = day.minutes > 0;\n\n            return (\n              <div\n                key={day.dateStr}\n                className=\"flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 h-full justify-end group relative\"\n              >\n                {/* Tooltip */}\n                <div className=\"absolute -top-7 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 pointer-events-none transition-opacity bg-slate-900 text-white text-[9px] py-0.5 px-1.5 rounded-md whitespace-nowrap z-20 font-mono\">\n                  {day.minutes}m ({day.conceptsTouched} {isAr ? 'مفاهيم' : 'concepts'})\n                </div>\n\n                <div\n                  className={`w-full max-w-[14px] rounded-t-md transition-all ${\n                    hasActivity\n                      ? 'bg-linear-to-t from-indigo-600 to-indigo-400'\n                      : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800'\n                  }`}\n                  style={{ height: `${heightPercent}%` }}\n                />\n                <span className=\"text-[8px] text-slate-400 truncate text-center\">\n                  {day.displayLabel}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n            );\n          })}\n        </div>\n\n        <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 pt-1\">\n          <span>{isAr ? 'الهدف: الاستمرارية المريحة والتعلم المستدام.' : 'Goal: Sustainable learning at your own pace.'}</span>\n          <span className=\"font-bold text-indigo-600\">\n            {gamification?.streak.currentDays || 1} {isAr ? 'أيام نشطة (سلسلة متسامحة)' : 'active days (forgiving)'}\n          </span>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* SECTION D & E: STRENGTHS & GROWTH AREAS */}\n      <div className=\"grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3\">\n        {/* Top 5 Strengths */}\n        <div className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm space-y-2\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n            <Award className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600\" />\n            <h4 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n              {isAr ? 'أبرز نقاط القوة (أعلى 5)' : 'Top Strengths (Top 5)'}\n            </h4>\n          </div>\n\n          {strengths.length === 0 ? (\n            <p className=\"text-[11px] text-slate-400 py-2\">\n              {isAr ? 'ابدأ بحل بعض التمارين لتظهر نقاط قوتك هنا.' : 'Complete some exercises to surface your strengths.'}\n            </p>\n          ) : (\n            <div className=\"space-y-1.5\">\n              {strengths.map((s, idx) => (\n                <div\n                  key={s.conceptId}\n                  className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50/60 dark:bg-emerald-950/30 border border-emerald-100 dark:border-emerald-900/40 flex items-center justify-between text-xs\"\n                >\n                  <div className=\"min-w-0 pr-2 rtl:pl-2 rtl:pr-0\">\n                    <span className=\"font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 block truncate\">\n                      {isAr ? s.nameAr : s.nameEn}\n                    </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-[9px] text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400\">\n                      {s.subject}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n                  <span className=\"text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 shrink-0\">\n                    {s.confidenceBand}\n                  </span>\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Growth Areas (Support Needed) */}\n        <div className=\"p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm space-y-2\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n            <Compass className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600\" />\n            <h4 className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100\">\n              {isAr ? 'فرص الدعم والتطوير' : 'Growth Areas (Support)'}\n            </h4>\n          </div>\n\n          {growthAreas.length === 0 ? (\n            <p className=\"text-[11px] text-slate-400 py-2\">\n              {isAr ? 'كافة المفاهيم المدروسة تسير بإتقان ممتاز.' : 'All concepts with evidence are in great standing.'}\n            </p>\n          ) : (\n            <div className=\"space-y-1.5\">\n              {growthAreas.map((g, idx) => (\n                <div\n                  key={g.conceptId}\n                  className=\"p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/60 flex items-center justify-between text-xs\"\n                >\n                  <div className=\"min-w-0 pr-2 rtl:pl-2 rtl:pr-0\">\n                    <span className=\"font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 block truncate\">\n                      {isAr ? g.nameAr : g.nameEn}\n                    </span>\n                    <span className=\"text-[9px] text-slate-400\">\n                      {g.subject}\n                    </span>\n                  </div>\n                  <span className=\"text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shrink-0\">\n                    {g.confidenceBand}\n                  </span>\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* SECTION A: KNOWLEDGE MAP (FULL TREE WITH BANDS) */}\n      <div className=\"space-y-2 pt-2\">\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          onClick={() => setShowKnowledgeMapFull(!showKnowledgeMapFull)}\n          className=\"w-full flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\"\n        >\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <Layers className=\"w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600\" />\n            <span>{isAr ? questionText={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.questionText}\n            options={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.options || []}\n            onAnswerSelected={(isCorrect) => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(isCorrect);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_build':\n        return (\n          <BuildCanvas\n            centerConcept={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.centerConcept || 'نهر النيل'}\n            nodes={currentBeat.interactionPayload?.nodes || []}\n            onBuildComplete={() => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_speak_answer':\n        return (\n          <VoiceAnswerControl\n            promptText={isAr ? currentBeat.nourTextAr : currentBeat.nourTextEn}\n            onAnswerSubmit={(text) => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'explain_back':\n        return (\n          <ExplainBackStage\n            conceptTitle={\n              currentBeat.interactionPayload?.conceptTitle ||\n              (isAr ? 'قسم حماية النيل' : 'Nile Protection Oath')\n            }\n            onExplainSubmitted={(explanation) => {\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              handleNextBeat(true);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n          />\n        );\n\n      case 'child_tap_object':\n      default:\n        return (\n          <div className=\"w-full h-full flex flex-col justify-center p-3 max-w-sm mx-auto space-y-2 animate-in fade-in duration-200\">\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => handleNextBeat(true)}\n              className=\"w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-slate-950 font-bold text-xs shadow-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer\"\n            >\n              <span>{isAr ? 'فهمت الفكرة يا نور، لنكمل!' : 'Understood Nour, let’s continue!'}</span>\n              {isAr ? <ChevronLeft className=\"w-4 h-4\" /> : <ChevronRight className=\"w-4 h-4\" />}\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        );\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div\n      className=\"fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-3 overflow-hidden select-none\"\n      dir={isAr ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}\n      onClick={() => {\n        // Unlock browser audio context on any modal click\n        if (!hasStartedAudio) {\n          setHasStartedAudio(true);\n          playTutorSpeech(tutorSpokenText);\n        }\n      }}\n    >\n      <div className=\"relative w-full max-w-xl h-full sm:h-[94vh] sm:max-h-[860px] bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700/80 rounded-none sm:rounded-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden\">\n        {/* TOP HEADER: TITLE, PROGRESS DOTS, VOICE CONTROLS & CHAT FALLBACK */}\n        <div className=\"px-3 py-2 bg-slate-900/90 text-white border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 z-30\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n            <div className=\"w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs\">\n              <Sparkles className=\"w-4 h-4 text-amber-300\" />\n            </div>\n            <div>\n              <h3 className=\"text-xs font-black tracking-tight flex items-center gap-1.5\">\n                <span>{isAr ? sequence.lessonTitleAr : sequence.lessonTitleEn}</span>\n                <span className=\"text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-500/30 text-indigo-300 font-bold\">\n                  {isAr ? `مع نور لـ ${studentName}` : `With Nour for ${studentName}`}\n                </span>\n              </h3>\n              <p className=\"text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-medium\">\n                {sequence.sourceRefText}\n              </p>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Center Beat Progress Dots */}\n          <div className=\"hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1\">\n            {sequence.beats.map((b, i) => (\n              <span\n                key={b.id}\n                className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${\n                  i === sessionState.currentBeatIndex\n                    ? 'w-5 bg-amber-400'\n                    : i < sessionState.currentBeatIndex\n                    ? 'w-2 bg-emerald-400'\n                    : 'w-1.5 bg-slate-700'\n                }`}\n              />\n            ))}\n          </div>\n\n          {/* Action Tools */}\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\n            {/* Talk to Nour (Fallback Chat Drawer Trigger) */}\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setShowChatFallback(!showChatFallback)}\n              className=\"p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer\"\n              title={isAr ? 'محادثة مفتوحة مع نور' : 'Talk to Nour'}\n              aria-label={isAr ? 'محادثة مفتوحة مع نور' : 'Talk to Nour'}\n            >\n              <MessageCircle className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            </button>\n\n            {/* Mute Toggle */}\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={handleToggleMute}\n              className={`p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ${\n                isMuted ? 'text-rose-400 bg-rose-950/40' : 'text-slate-400 hover:text-white'\n              }`}\n              title={isMuted ? (isAr ? 'تشغيل الصوت' : 'Unmute') : isAr ? 'كتم الصوت' : 'Mute'}\n              aria-label={isMuted ? (isAr ? 'تشغيل الصوت' : 'Unmute') : isAr ? 'كتم الصوت' : 'Mute'}\n            >\n              {isMuted ? <VolumeX className=\"w-4 h-4\" /> : <Volume2 className=\"w-4 h-4\" />}\n            </button>\n\n            {/* Close */}\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={onClose}\n              className=\"p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer\"\n              title={isAr ? 'إغلاق' : 'Close'}\n              aria-label={isAr ? 'إغلاق' : 'Close'}\n            >\n              <X className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n            </button>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        {/* Browser Audio Unlock Reminder Banner */}\n        {!hasStartedAudio && !isMuted && (\n          <div\n            onClick={(e) => {\n              e.stopPropagation();\n              setHasStartedAudio(true);\n              playTutorSpeech(tutorSpokenText);\n            }}\n            className=\"w-full bg-linear-to-r from-amber-500 via-amber-400 to-yellow-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-xs py-1.5 px-3 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer shadow-md animate-pulse z-40\"\n          >\n            <Volume2 className=\"w-4 h-4 animate-bounce\" />\n            <span>{isAr ? 'اضغطي هنا لتشغيل صوت نور التفاعلي 🔊' : 'Tap here to enable Nour’s voice 🔊'}</span>\n          </div>\n        )}\n\n        {/* 1. TOP 55%: SCENE CANVAS */}\n        <div className=\"h-[55%] w-full relative shrink-0\">\n          <StageSceneCanvas\n            nourState={sessionState.nourCurrentState}\n            outfit={sequence.outfit}\n            isNourSpeaking={isSpeaking}\n            clipId={currentBeat?.scenePayload?.clipId}\n            interactiveObjects={currentBeat?.scenePayload?.interactiveObjects}\n            onObjectTap={(obj) => {\n              const text = isAr ? obj.descriptionAr : obj.descriptionEn;\n              setTutorSpokenText(text);\n              playTutorSpeech(text);\n            }}\n            language={language}\n            onNourTap={handleReplayVoice}\n          />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 2. MIDDLE 20%: NARRATION BAR */}\n        <div className=\"h-[20%] w-full shrink-0 flex flex-col justify-center\">\n          <NarrationBar\n            spokenText={tutorSpokenText}\n            isSpeaking={isSpeaking}\n            isMuted={isMuted}\n            sourceRefText={`ص. ${currentBeat?.sourcePage || 12}`}\n            language={language}\n            onReplayAudio={handleReplayVoice}\n            onToggleMute={handleToggleMute}\n          />\n        </div>\n\n        {/* 3. BOTTOM 25%: INTERACTION BAR */}\n        <div className=\"h-[25%] w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shrink-0 overflow-y-auto\">\n          {renderInteractionZone()}\n        </div>\n\n        {/* FALLBACK CHAT DRAWER (\"Talk to Nour\" - Sub-Phase 11.7) */}\n        {showChatFallback && (\n          <div className=\"absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-[65%] z-40 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border-t-2 border-indigo-500 rounded-t-3xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col animate-in slide-in-from-bottom duration-300\">\n            <div className=\"p-3 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border-b border-indigo-100 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between\">\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                <MessageCircle className=\"w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600\" />\n                <span className=\"text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200\">\n                  {isAr ? `محادثة مفتوحة مع نور يا ${studentName}` : `Talk to Nour, ${studentName}`}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                onClick={() => setShowChatFallback(false)}\n                className=\"p-1 rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-200 cursor-pointer\"\n              >\n                <X className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\n              </button>\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Chat History */}\n            <div className=\"flex-1 p-3 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 text-xs\">\n              <div className=\"p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 leading-relaxed\">\n                {isAr\n                  ? `أهلاً يا ${studentName}! أنا رفيقتكِ ومعلمتكِ نور. لو فيه أي سؤال في درس «${sequence.lessonTitleAr}» مش فاهماه أو سؤال يدور في ذهنكِ، احكيلي براحتك خالص!`\n                  : `Hi ${studentName}! I’m Nour. If anything in \"${sequence.lessonTitleEn}\" isn't clear or you have any curious thought, ask me freely!`}\n              </div>\n\n              {chatMessages.map((msg, i) => (\n                <div\n                  key={i}\n                  className={`flex ${msg.role === 'child' ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}\n                >\n                  <div\n                    className={`max-w-[85%] p-2.5 rounded-2xl ${\n                      msg.role === 'child'\n                        ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white'\n                        : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100'\n                    }`}\n                  >\n                    {msg.text}\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n\n            {/* Chat Input */}\n            <form onSubmit={handleSendFallbackChat} className=\"p-2 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex gap-2\">\n              <input\n                type=\"text\"\n                value={chatInput}\n                onChange={(e) => setChatInput(e.target.value)}\n                placeholder={isAr ? 'اسألي نور أي سؤال...' : 'Ask Nour anything...'}\n                className=\"flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500\"\n              />\n              <button\n                type=\"submit\"\n                disabled={!chatInput.trim()}\n                className=\"px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-40 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer\"\n              >\n                {isAr ? 'إرسال' : 'Send'}\n              </button>\n            </form>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n",
 "new_content": "/**\n * @license\n * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n */\n\nimport React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useApp } from '../../context/AppContext';\nimport {\n  StageLessonSequence,\n  StageSessionState,\n  BeatDefinition,\n  NourState,\n} from '../../types/stage';\nimport { stageEngine } from '../../services/stage/stageEngine';\nimport { voiceService } from '../../services/voice/voiceService';\nimport { storageService } from '../../services/storage';\nimport { StageSceneCanvas } from './StageSceneCanvas';\nimport { NarrationBar } from './NarrationBar';\n\n// Toolkit Interactions\nimport { TapWordCard } from './interactions/TapWordCard';\nimport { MatchPairsBoard } from './interactions/MatchPairsBoard';\nimport { DragDropMat } from './interactions/DragDropMat';\nimport { TraceCanvas } from './interactions/TraceCanvas';\nimport { ChoiceCard } from './interactions/ChoiceCard';\nimport { BuildCanvas } from './interactions/BuildCanvas';\nimport { VoiceAnswerControl } from './interactions/VoiceAnswerControl';\nimport { ExplainBackStage } from './interactions/ExplainBackStage';\nimport { resolveStudentName } from '../../utils/studentAddress';\n\nimport {\n  X,\n  Volume2,\n  VolumeX,\n  MessageCircle,\n  Sparkles,\n  ChevronRight,\n  ChevronLeft,\n  HelpCircle,\n  Send,\n  Heart,\n  Lightbulb,\n} from 'lucide-react';\n\ninterface StageModalProps {\n  lessonId: string;\n  onClose: () => void;\n  onSessionComplete?: () => void;\n}\n\n/**\n * THE STAGE — The Interactive Human-Like Animated Multimodal Tutor Modal\n * (Phase 11 & Sub-Phase 11.2 - 11.9)\n *\n * Implements an interactive private tutor (Nour) who:\n * 1. Speaks aloud with synchronized word-by-word highlights.\n * 2. Actively asks Amina if she understood after each explanation.\n * 3. Fulfils explanations with warm, relatable real-life Egyptian examples when asked.\n * 4. Answers Amina's questions dynamically in friendly conversation.\n * 5. Guides her through touch, calligraphy tracing, concept building, and explain-back.\n */\nexport const StageModal: React.FC<StageModalProps> = ({\n  lessonId,\n  onClose,\n  onSessionComplete,\n}) => {\n  const { language, recordEvidence, showToast, student } = useApp();\n  const isAr = language === 'ar';\n  const studentName = resolveStudentName(student?.name, isAr);\n\n  const [sequence] = useState<StageLessonSequence>(() =>\n    stageEngine.getSequenceForLesson(lessonId)\n  );\n\n  const [sessionState, setSessionState] = useState<StageSessionState>(() =>\n    stageEngine.initSession(lessonId)\n  );\n\n  const [isSpeaking, setIsSpeaking] = useState(false);\n  const [isMuted, setIsMuted] = useState(false);\n  const [hasStartedAudio, setHasStartedAudio] = useState(false);\n\n  // Conversational Tutor state\n  const [tutorSpokenText, setTutorSpokenText] = useState<string>('');\n  const [isAskingClarification, setIsAskingClarification] = useState(false);\n  const [showQuestionInput, setShowQuestionInput] = useState(false);\n  const [customQuestionInput, setCustomQuestionInput] = useState('');\n  const [isAnsweringQuestion, setIsAnsweringQuestion] = useState(false);\n\n  // Chat Drawer Fallback state\n  const [showChatFallback, setShowChatFallback] = useState(false);\n  const [chatInput, setChatInput] = useState('');\n  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState<Array<{ role: 'nour' | 'child'; text: string }>>([]);\n\n  const currentBeat: BeatDefinition | undefined =\n    sequence.beats[sessionState.currentBeatIndex];\n\n  // Helper to speak and update state\n  const playTutorSpeech = (text: string) => {\n    if (isMuted) return;\n    setIsSpeaking(true);\n    setHasStartedAudio(true);\n    voiceService.unlockAudio();\n\n    voiceService.speak(\n      text,\n      isAr ? 'ar' : 'en',\n      () => setIsSpeaking(true),\n      () => setIsSpeaking(false),\n      () => setIsSpeaking(false)\n    );\n  };\n\n  // Sync spoken text when beat changes\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!currentBeat) return;\n\n    let baseText = isAr ? currentBeat.nourTextAr : currentBeat.nourTextEn;\n    // Personalize the neutral {{name}} placeholder with the real student's name\n    baseText = baseText.replace(/\\{\\{name\\}\\}/g, studentName);\n\n    setTutorSpokenText(baseText);\n    setIsAskingClarification(false);\n    setShowQuestionInput(false);\n\n    // If user has already interacted, speak immediately\n    if (hasStartedAudio && !isMuted) {\n      playTutorSpeech(baseText);\n    }\n\n    return () => {\n      voiceService.cancelSpeech();\n    };\n  }, [currentBeat?.id, hasStartedAudio, isMuted, isAr, studentName]);\n\n  const handleNextBeat = async (childSuccess: boolean = true) => {\n    voiceService.cancelSpeech();\n    setIsSpeaking(false);\n    setHasStartedAudio(true);\n\n    const { newState, result } = stageEngine.advanceBeat(sessionState, childSuccess);\n    setSessionState(newState);\n\n    // Record invisible mastery evidence\n    if (result.masteryEvidence) {\n      await recordEvidence(result.masteryEvidence.conceptId, {\n        correctness: result.masteryEvidence.correctness,\n        difficulty: 0.5,\n        independence: result.masteryEvidence.independence,\n        modality: result.masteryEvidence.modality,\n        notes: `The Stage: Beat ${currentBeat?.type} in ${sequence.lessonTitleAr}`,\n      });\n    }\n\n    // Save session in IndexedDB if active student exists\n    if (student?.id) {\n      await storageService.saveTeachingSession({\n        sessionId: `stage_sess_${lessonId}`,\n        studentId: student.id,\n        lessonId,\n        subjectId: sequence.subjectId,\n        startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        currentConceptIndex: newState.currentBeatIndex,\n        totalConcepts: sequence.beats.length,\n        currentStep: 'teach',\n        currentAttemptCount: 0,\n        modalityHistory: ['structured_visual'],\n        turnHistory: [],\n        explainBackDone: Object.values(newState.explainBackPassed).some(Boolean),\n        offBookQuestions: newState.offBookQuestions.map((q) => ({\n          question: q,\n          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n          parentNote: `سؤال استكشافي من المسرح التفاعلي: \"${q}\"`,\n        })),\n        status: result.isLessonCompleted ? 'completed' : 'in_progress',\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (result.isLessonCompleted) {\n      showToast(\n        isAr\n          ? `🎉 مبارك يا ${studentName}! أتممتِ جلسة المسرح التفاعلي لدرس «${sequence.lessonTitleAr}» بنجاح باهر!`\n          : `🎉 Congratulations ${studentName}! You completed The Stage for \"${sequence.lessonTitleEn}\"!`\n      );\n      onSessionComplete?.();\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Conversational Action: When Amina says \"مش فاهماها أوي.. وضحيلي بمثال\"\n  const handleExplainWithAnalogy = () => {\n    setHasStartedAudio(true);\n    setIsAskingClarification(true);\n    setSessionState((prev) => ({ ...prev, nourCurrentState: 'encouraging' }));\n\n    const analogyText = isAr\n      ? `ولا يهمك خالص يا ${studentName} يا حبيبتي! تعالي نتخيلها بمثال من بيتنا: لو المية اتقطعت عن البيت يوم كامل في الصيف.. لا هنعرف نشرب، ولا ماما هتعرف تطبخ، والزرع هيموت! عشان كده أجدادنا الفراعنة كانوا بيعتبروا النيل مش مجرد نهر عادي، ده سر الحياة، وكانوا بيقسموا إنهم ميوسخوهوش أبداً بإلقاء القمامة. ها، كده الرؤية وضحت في دماغك؟`\n      : `Don't worry at all, ${studentName}! Picture this: if water was shut off at home for an entire day, we couldn't drink, cook, or water plants! That's why ancient Egyptians swore to never pollute the Nile. Does that make sense now?`;\n\n    setTutorSpokenText(analogyText);\n    playTutorSpeech(analogyText);\n  };\n\n  // Conversational Action: When Amina asks \"يعني إيه الكلمة دي؟\"\n  const handleExplainWordMeaning = () => {\n    setHasStartedAudio(true);\n    setIsAskingClarification(true);\n    setSessionState((prev) => ({ ...prev, nourCurrentState: 'talking' }));\n\n    const meaningText = isAr\n      ? `بصي يا ${studentName}: كلمة «لم أوتِ» معناها في اللغة المصرية القديمة: لم أدنّس، ولم ألوّث، ولم أفسد طهارة ماء النهر أبداً بإلقاء المخلفات. كلمة قوية جداً بتدل على احترامهم العظيم للنيل!`\n      : `Look ${studentName}: \"لم أوت\" means: I have never defiled, polluted, or spoiled the purity of the river water with waste. It shows deep respect for the Nile!`;\n\n    setTutorSpokenText(meaningText);\n    playTutorSpeech(meaningText);\n  };\n\n  // Conversational Action: When Amina asks an open question\n  const handleSendCustomQuery = async () => {\n    const query = customQuestionInput.trim();\n    if (!query) return;\n\n    setHasStartedAudio(true);\n    setIsAnsweringQuestion(true);\n    setCustomQuestionInput('');\n    setSessionState((prev) => ({ ...prev, nourCurrentState: 'thinking' }));\n\n    try {\n      const resp = await fetch('/api/tutor-reply', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          studentInput: query,\n          currentBeatText: tutorSpokenText,\n          language: isAr ? 'ar' : 'en',\n        }),\n      });\n\n      const data = await resp.json();\n      const reply = data.reply || (isAr ? `أنا معاكي يا ${studentName}، وضحت ليكي الفكرة؟` : `I'm with you ${studentName}!`);\n\n      setSessionState((prev) => ({ ...prev, nourCurrentState: 'talking' }));\n      setTutorSpokenText(reply);\n      playTutorSpeech(reply);\n      setIsAskingClarification(true);\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.warn('tutor-reply error:', e);\n    } finally {\n      setIsAnsweringQuestion(false);\n      setShowQuestionInput(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleReplayVoice = () => {\n    if (!tutorSpokenText) return;\n    playTutorSpeech(tutorSpokenText);\n  };\n\n  const handleToggleMute = () => {\n    if (!isMuted) {\n      voiceService.cancelSpeech();\n      setIsSpeaking(false);\n    }\n    setIsMuted(!isMuted);\n  };\n\n  // Fallback Chat Handler (routes off-book questions safely)\n  const handleSendFallbackChat = (e: React.FormEvent) => {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const query = chatInput.trim();\n    if (!query) return;\n\n    setChatMessages((prev) => [...prev, { role: 'child', text: query }]);\n    setChatInput('');\n\n    const lower = query.toLowerCase();\n    const isOffBook =\n      lower.includes('فضاء') ||\n      lower.includes('ديناصور') ||\n      lower.includes('كورة') ||\n      lower.includes('space');\n\n    if (isOffBook) {\n      setSessionState((prev) => ({\n        ...prev,\n        offBookQuestions: [...prev.offBookQuestions, query],\n      }));\n      setChatMessages((prev) => [\n        ...prev,\n        {\n          role: 'nour',\n          text: isAr\n            ? `سؤال ذكي وفضولي جداً يا ${studentName}! لكنه خارج كتابنا لدرس اليوم (${sequence.sourceRefText}). دعيني أركز معكِ على الدرس وسجلت سؤالكِ الجميل لمناقشته مع والديك!`\n            : `That’s a brilliant curious question ${studentName}! It’s not in our textbook lesson today though. Let’s focus on your lesson, and I saved your great question for family talk!`,\n        },\n      ]);\n    } else {\n      setChatMessages((prev) => [\n        ...prev,\n        {\n          role: 'nour',\n          text: isAr\n            ? `أنا معاكي يا ${studentName}! نحن ندرس معاً درس «${sequence.lessonTitleAr}» من صفحة ${currentBeat?.sourcePage || 12}. دعينا نركز في هذه الخطوة الجميلة!`\n            : `I'm with you, ${studentName}!
